Based on an analysis of various real OpenClaw usage cases, we derive a Triple-Axis Complexity Framework that characterizes task difficulty along three dimensions: Environment Complexity, Cognitive Demand, and Runtime Adaptability. Guided by this framework, we construct a pilot benchmark with explicit complexity-factor annotations, covering real-world assistant tasks with compositional difficulty. Together, the framework and benchmark provide a principled foundation for evaluating LLM agents in realistic assistant settings, and establish a basis for future expansion across task domains and complexity axes. We are continuing to enrich our case collections to achieve more comprehensive domain and complexity coverage. The project page is at https://github.com/Mosi-AI/LiveClawBench.

AI.tldr: LiveClawBench是一个评估LLM智能体在真实世界助手任务中表现的基准测试，基于OpenClaw实际使用案例分析，提出了三轴复杂度框架来衡量任务难度
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试通常在孤立的难度源下评估LLM智能体，如单一环境或完全指定的指令，这与实际部署中出现的组合挑战存在显著差距
AI.method: 基于OpenClaw实际使用案例分析，提出了三轴复杂度框架（环境复杂度、认知需求、运行时适应性），并构建了带有明确复杂度因子标注的试点基准
AI.result: 创建了LiveClawBench基准测试，为在现实助手设置中评估LLM智能体提供了原则性基础，并为未来跨任务领域和复杂度轴的扩展建立了基础
AI.conclusion: 该框架和基准测试为评估LLM智能体在现实助手设置中提供了系统方法，团队正在继续丰富案例收集以实现更全面的领域和复杂度覆盖

title: PAT-VCM: Plug-and-Play Auxiliary Tokens for Video Coding for Machines
summary: Existing video coding for machines is often trained for a specific downstream task and model. As a result, the compressed representation becomes tightly coupled to the end task, making it difficult to scale across multiple tasks or adapt to model updates. We propose PAT-VCM, a plug-and-play auxiliary-token framework for video coding for machines. PAT-VCM keeps a shared baseline compressed stream and augments it with lightweight task-aware auxiliary tokens, allowing different downstream tasks to recover the information they need without retraining a separate codec for each task. The framework supports three forms of auxiliary information: visual residual tokens, prompt/control tokens, and semantic tokens. We evaluate PAT-VCM on segmentation, depth estimation, and semantic recognition. A shared detection-oriented auxiliary branch provides a reusable first refinement, task-specific visual branches improve segmentation and depth, prompt tokens provide further segmentation gains at negligible bitrate, and semantic tokens achieve strong recognition performance with extremely low overhead. These results suggest that a shared compressed representation, combined with lightweight task-aware auxiliary tokens, is a practical and scalable alternative to tightly task-coupled VCM design.

AI.tldr: PAT-VCM提出了一种用于机器视觉视频编码的即插即用辅助令牌框架，通过共享基础压缩流和轻量级任务感知辅助令牌，实现跨多个下游任务的可扩展编码，避免为每个任务单独训练编解码器。
AI.motivation: 现有机器视觉视频编码通常针对特定下游任务和模型进行训练，导致压缩表示与终端任务紧密耦合，难以扩展到多个任务或适应模型更新。
AI.method: 提出PAT-VCM框架，保持共享的基础压缩流，并通过轻量级任务感知辅助令牌进行增强，支持三种辅助信息形式：视觉残差令牌、提示/控制令牌和语义令牌。
AI.result: 在分割、深度估计和语义识别任务上评估PAT-VCM：共享检测导向的辅助分支提供可重用的首次细化，任务特定视觉分支改进分割和深度，提示令牌以可忽略的比特率提供进一步分割增益，语义令牌以极低开销实现强识别性能。
AI.conclusion: 共享压缩表示结合轻量级任务感知辅助令牌是紧密任务耦合VCM设计的实用且可扩展的替代方案。

title: TREX: Automating LLM Fine-tuning via Agent-Driven Tree-based Exploration
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have empowered AI research agents to perform isolated scientific tasks, automating complex, real-world workflows, such as LLM training, remains a significant challenge. In this paper, we introduce TREX, a multi-agent system that automates the entire LLM training life-cycle. By orchestrating collaboration between two core modules-the Researcher and the Executor-the system seamlessly performs requirement analysis, open-domain literature and data research, formulation of training strategies, preparation of data recipes, and model training and evaluation. The multi-round experimental process is modeled as a search tree, enabling the system to efficiently plan exploration paths, reuse historical results, and distill high-level insights from iterative trials. To evaluate the capability of automated LLM training, we construct FT-Bench, a benchmark comprising 10 tasks derived from real-world scenarios, ranging from optimizing fundamental model capabilities to enhancing performance on domain-specific tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that the TREX agent consistently optimizes model performance on target tasks.

AI.tldr: TREX是一个多智能体系统，能够自动化整个LLM训练生命周期，通过研究者和执行者模块的协作，实现从需求分析到模型训练评估的全流程自动化。
AI.motivation: 虽然大语言模型已经赋能AI研究代理执行孤立的科学任务，但自动化复杂的真实世界工作流程（如LLM训练）仍然是一个重大挑战。现有方法难以处理从需求分析到模型训练评估的完整流程。
AI.method: TREX采用多智能体系统架构，包含研究者（Researcher）和执行者（Executor）两个核心模块。系统将多轮实验过程建模为搜索树，能够高效规划探索路径、重用历史结果，并从迭代试验中提炼高层洞察。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，TREX代理能够持续优化目标任务的模型性能。研究者构建了FT-Bench基准测试，包含10个来自真实场景的任务，涵盖从优化基础模型能力到提升领域特定任务性能的范围。
AI.conclusion: TREX系统成功实现了LLM训练生命周期的自动化，通过多智能体协作和搜索树建模，能够有效处理复杂的真实世界工作流程，为自动化AI研究提供了新的解决方案。

title: OmniTrace: A Unified Framework for Generation-Time Attribution in Omni-Modal LLMs
summary: Modern multimodal large language models (MLLMs) generate fluent responses from interleaved text, image, audio, and video inputs. However, identifying which input sources support each generated statement remains an open challenge. Existing attribution methods are primarily designed for classification settings, fixed prediction targets, or single-modality architectures, and do not naturally extend to autoregressive, decoder-only models performing open-ended multimodal generation. We introduce OmniTrace, a lightweight and model-agnostic framework that formalizes attribution as a generation-time tracing problem over the causal decoding process. OmniTrace provides a unified protocol that converts arbitrary token-level signals such as attention weights or gradient-based scores into coherent span-level, cross-modal explanations during decoding. It traces each generated token to multimodal inputs, aggregates signals into semantically meaningful spans, and selects concise supporting sources through confidence-weighted and temporally coherent aggregation, without retraining or supervision. Evaluations on Qwen2.5-Omni and MiniCPM-o-4.5 across visual, audio, and video tasks demonstrate that generation-aware span-level attribution produces more stable and interpretable explanations than naive self-attribution and embedding-based baselines, while remaining robust across multiple underlying attribution signals. Our results suggest that treating attribution as a structured generation-time tracing problem provides a scalable foundation for transparency in omni-modal language models.

AI.tldr: OmniTrace是一个轻量级、模型无关的框架，将归因问题形式化为生成时的追踪问题，为多模态大语言模型提供跨模态、跨层级的解释，无需重新训练或监督。
AI.motivation: 现有归因方法主要针对分类设置、固定预测目标或单模态架构设计，无法自然扩展到自回归、仅解码器模型执行开放式多模态生成任务。识别生成语句由哪些输入源支持仍然是一个开放挑战。
AI.method: OmniTrace将归因形式化为因果解码过程中的生成时追踪问题，提供统一协议将任意令牌级信号（如注意力权重或基于梯度的分数）转换为解码过程中的连贯跨模态解释。它追踪每个生成令牌到多模态输入，将信号聚合为语义上有意义的跨度，并通过置信度加权和时间一致性聚合选择简洁的支持源。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-Omni和MiniCPM-o-4.5模型上的视觉、音频和视频任务评估表明，生成感知的跨度级归因比朴素自归因和基于嵌入的基线方法产生更稳定和可解释的解释，同时对多种底层归因信号保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 将归因视为结构化生成时追踪问题为全模态语言模型的透明度提供了可扩展的基础。OmniTrace框架无需重新训练或监督，能够提供模型无关的跨模态解释。

title: Can Cross-Layer Transcoders Replace Vision Transformer Activations? An Interpretable Perspective on Vision
summary: Understanding the internal activations of Vision Transformers (ViTs) is critical for building interpretable and trustworthy models. While Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) have been used to extract human-interpretable features, they operate on individual layers and fail to capture the cross-layer computational structure of Transformers, as well as the relative significance of each layer in forming the last-layer representation. Alternatively, we introduce the adoption of Cross-Layer Transcoders (CLTs) as reliable, sparse, and depth-aware proxy models for MLP blocks in ViTs. CLTs use an encoder-decoder scheme to reconstruct each post-MLP activation from learned sparse embeddings of preceding layers, yielding a linear decomposition that transforms the final representation of ViTs from an opaque embedding into an additive, layer-resolved construction that enables faithful attribution and process-level interpretability. We train CLTs on CLIP ViT-B/32 and ViT-B/16 across CIFAR-100, COCO, and ImageNet-100. We show that CLTs achieve high reconstruction fidelity with post-MLP activations while preserving and even improving, in some cases, CLIP zero-shot classification accuracy. In terms of interpretability, we show that the cross-layer contribution scores provide faithful attribution, revealing that the final representation is concentrated in a smaller set of dominant layer-wise terms whose removal degrades performance and whose retention largely preserves it. These results showcase the significance of adopting CLTs as an alternative interpretable proxy of ViTs in the vision domain.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出跨层转码器（CLTs）作为ViT中MLP块的可靠、稀疏且深度感知的代理模型，通过编码器-解码器方案重构每层后MLP激活，将最终表示分解为可加性的层解析构造，实现忠实归因和过程级可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有稀疏自编码器（SAEs）仅针对单层操作，无法捕捉Transformer的跨层计算结构及各层对最终表示的重要性。需要一种能够理解ViT内部激活、提供跨层可解释性的方法。
AI.method: 引入跨层转码器（CLTs），采用编码器-解码器方案，从先前层学习的稀疏嵌入中重构每层后MLP激活，获得线性分解，将ViT最终表示从不透明嵌入转化为可加性的层解析构造。
AI.result: 在CLIP ViT-B/32和ViT-B/16上训练CLTs，在CIFAR-100、COCO和ImageNet-100数据集上实现高重构保真度，保持甚至提升CLIP零样本分类准确率。跨层贡献分数提供忠实归因，显示最终表示集中在少量主导层间项中。
AI.conclusion: CLTs作为ViT的可解释代理模型在视觉领域具有重要意义，能够提供跨层计算结构的深度感知理解，实现过程级可解释性和忠实归因。

title: PersonaVLM: Long-Term Personalized Multimodal LLMs
comment: Accepted by CVPR 2026. Project page: https://PersonaVLM.github.io
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) serve as daily assistants for millions. However, their ability to generate responses aligned with individual preferences remains limited. Prior approaches enable only static, single-turn personalization through input augmentation or output alignment, and thus fail to capture users' evolving preferences and personality over time (see Fig.1). In this paper, we introduce PersonaVLM, an innovative personalized multimodal agent framework designed for long-term personalization. It transforms a general-purpose MLLM into a personalized assistant by integrating three key capabilities: (a) Remembering: It proactively extracts and summarizes chronological multimodal memories from interactions, consolidating them into a personalized database. (b) Reasoning: It conducts multi-turn reasoning by retrieving and integrating relevant memories from the database. (c) Response Alignment: It infers the user's evolving personality throughout long-term interactions to ensure outputs remain aligned with their unique characteristics. For evaluation, we establish Persona-MME, a comprehensive benchmark comprising over 2,000 curated interaction cases, designed to assess long-term MLLM personalization across seven key aspects and 14 fine-grained tasks. Extensive experiments validate our method's effectiveness, improving the baseline by 22.4% (Persona-MME) and 9.8% (PERSONAMEM) under a 128k context, while outperforming GPT-4o by 5.2% and 2.0%, respectively. Project page: https://PersonaVLM.github.io.

AI.tldr: PersonaVLM是一个个性化多模态大语言模型框架，通过记忆、推理和响应对齐三个核心能力实现长期个性化，在多个基准测试中显著优于基线模型和GPT-4o。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大语言模型虽然作为日常助手服务数百万人，但缺乏根据用户个性化偏好生成响应的能力。现有方法仅支持静态、单轮次的个性化，无法捕捉用户随时间演变的偏好和个性特征。
AI.method: 提出PersonaVLM框架，将通用MLLM转化为个性化助手，包含三个关键能力：1) 记忆能力：主动提取和总结交互中的时序多模态记忆，构建个性化数据库；2) 推理能力：通过检索和整合相关记忆进行多轮推理；3) 响应对齐：推断用户在长期交互中演变的个性特征，确保输出与其独特特性保持一致。
AI.result: 建立了Persona-MME基准测试，包含2000多个精心策划的交互案例，涵盖7个关键方面和14个细粒度任务。实验表明，在128k上下文下，PersonaVLM比基线模型提升22.4%（Persona-MME）和9.8%（PERSONAMEM），同时分别优于GPT-4o 5.2%和2.0%。
AI.conclusion: PersonaVLM通过记忆、推理和响应对齐的集成框架，成功实现了多模态大语言模型的长期个性化，显著提升了模型对用户个性化需求的适应能力，为构建更智能的个性化助手提供了有效解决方案。

title: Bias at the End of the Score
comment: Accepted to The IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) 2026
summary: Reward models (RMs) are inherently non-neutral value functions designed and trained to encode specific objectives, such as human preferences or text-image alignment. RMs have become crucial components of text-to-image (T2I) generation systems where they are used at various stages for dataset filtering, as evaluation metrics, as a supervisory signal during optimization of parameters, and for post-generation safety and quality filtering of T2I outputs. While specific problems with the integration of RMs into the T2I pipeline have been studied (e.g. reward hacking or mode collapse), their robustness and fairness as scoring functions remains largely unknown. We conduct a large scale audit of RM robustness with respect to demographic biases during T2I model training and generation. We provide quantitative and qualitative evidence that while originally developed as quality measures, RMs encode demographic biases, which cause reward-guided optimization to disproportionately sexualize female image subjects reinforce gender/racial stereotypes, and collapse demographic diversity. These findings highlight shortcomings in current reward models, challenge their reliability as quality metrics, and underscore the need for improved data collection and training procedures to enable more robust scoring.

AI.tldr: 奖励模型在文本到图像生成中存在人口统计偏见，导致优化过程中过度性化女性形象、强化刻板印象并减少多样性
AI.motivation: 奖励模型已成为文本到图像生成系统的关键组件，用于数据集过滤、评估指标、优化监督信号和输出过滤。虽然奖励模型集成中的特定问题（如奖励黑客攻击或模式崩溃）已被研究，但其作为评分函数的鲁棒性和公平性仍不清楚。本研究旨在审计奖励模型在人口统计偏见方面的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 对奖励模型鲁棒性进行大规模审计，重点关注文本到图像模型训练和生成过程中的人口统计偏见。通过定量和定性分析评估奖励模型作为质量度量时编码的人口统计偏见。
AI.result: 研究发现奖励模型编码了人口统计偏见，导致奖励引导的优化过程中：1）过度性化女性图像主体；2）强化性别/种族刻板印象；3）减少人口统计多样性。这些偏见影响了奖励模型作为质量度量的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 当前奖励模型存在显著缺陷，挑战了其作为质量度量的可靠性。研究强调需要改进数据收集和训练程序，以实现更鲁棒的评分功能。

title: DeEscalWild: A Real-World Benchmark for Automated De-Escalation Training with SLMs
summary: Effective de-escalation is critical for law enforcement safety and community trust, yet traditional training methods lack scalability and realism. While Large Language Models (LLMs) enable dynamic, open-ended simulations, their substantial computational footprint renders them impractical for deployment on the lightweight, portable hardware required for immersive field training. Small Language Models (SLMs) offer a viable real-time alternative but suffer from a critical scarcity of high-quality, domain-specific training data. To bridge this gap, we present DeEscalWild, a novel benchmark dataset curated from a multi-stage pipeline of in-the-wild police-civilian interactions extracted from open-source video repositories. Starting with 5,000 raw inputs, we employed a rigorous hybrid filtering process - combining human-in-the-loop verification with LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation - to distill 1,500 high-fidelity scenarios. The resulting corpus comprises 285,887 dialogue turns, totaling approximately 4.7 million tokens. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SLMs fine-tuned on this data significantly outperform their base counterparts across ROUGE-L, BLEU-4, METEOR, and BERTScore metrics. Notably, our fine-tuned Qwen 2.5 (3B-Instruct) surpasses the general-purpose Gemini 2.5 Flash model, demonstrating that domain-optimized SLMs can achieve superior performance with a fraction of the computational cost. This work establishes the foundational infrastructure for accessible, low-latency, and privacy-preserving officer training systems at the edge.

AI.tldr: DeEscalWild是一个用于警察-平民冲突降级训练的基准数据集，通过多阶段筛选从公开视频中提取了1,500个高质量场景，包含28.5万对话轮次，约470万tokens。使用该数据集微调的小语言模型在各项指标上显著优于基础模型，甚至超越通用大模型。
AI.motivation: 传统执法降级训练方法缺乏可扩展性和真实性，而大语言模型虽然能提供动态模拟但计算成本过高，不适合轻量级便携设备。小语言模型可作为实时替代方案，但缺乏高质量的领域特定训练数据。
AI.method: 从公开视频库中提取5,000个原始警察-平民互动数据，通过人机协同的混合筛选流程（人类验证+LLM作为评判）提炼出1,500个高保真场景，构建包含285,887个对话轮次的DeEscalWild数据集。
AI.result: 使用DeEscalWild微调的小语言模型在ROUGE-L、BLEU-4、METEOR和BERTScore等指标上显著优于基础模型。微调的Qwen 2.5 (3B-Instruct)甚至超越了通用Gemini 2.5 Flash模型，证明领域优化的小模型能以更低的计算成本获得更优性能。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为边缘设备上可访问、低延迟、保护隐私的警官训练系统建立了基础架构，证明了领域特定数据集对于小语言模型在执法降级训练中的有效性。

title: Deep Spatially-Regularized and Superpixel-Based Diffusion Learning for Unsupervised Hyperspectral Image Clustering
summary: An unsupervised framework for hyperspectral image (HSI) clustering is proposed that incorporates masked deep representation learning with diffusion-based clustering, extending the Spatially-Regularized Superpixel-based Diffusion Learning ($S^2DL$) algorithm. Initially, a denoised latent representation of the original HSI is learned via an unsupervised masked autoencoder (UMAE) model with a Vision Transformer backbone. The UMAE takes spatial context and long-range spectral correlations into account and incorporates an efficient pretraining process via masking that utilizes only a small subset of training pixels. In the next stage, the entropy rate superpixel (ERS) algorithm is used to segment the image into superpixels, and a spatially regularized diffusion graph is constructed using Euclidean and diffusion distances within the compressed latent space instead of the HSI space. The proposed algorithm, Deep Spatially-Regularized Superpixel-based Diffusion Learning ($DS^2DL$), leverages more faithful diffusion distances and subsequent diffusion graph construction that better reflect the intrinsic geometry of the underlying data manifold, improving labeling accuracy and clustering quality. Experiments on Botswana and KSC datasets demonstrate the efficacy of $DS^2DL$.

AI.tldr: 提出DS²DL算法，结合掩码深度表示学习与扩散聚类，通过无监督掩码自编码器学习HSI的降噪潜在表示，再基于超像素构建空间正则化扩散图，提升高光谱图像聚类精度。
AI.motivation: 传统高光谱图像聚类方法在捕捉数据内在几何结构和处理噪声方面存在局限，需要结合深度表示学习和扩散聚类来提升聚类质量。
AI.method: 1. 使用基于Vision Transformer的无监督掩码自编码器(UMAE)学习降噪潜在表示；2. 利用熵率超像素(ERS)算法分割图像；3. 在压缩潜在空间而非原始HSI空间中构建空间正则化扩散图；4. 结合欧氏距离和扩散距离构建扩散图。
AI.result: 在Botswana和KSC数据集上的实验表明，DS²DL算法能够更准确地反映数据流形的内在几何结构，显著提高了标注精度和聚类质量。
AI.conclusion: DS²DL通过深度表示学习和扩散聚类的结合，有效提升了高光谱图像聚类的性能，为无监督HSI分析提供了新框架。

title: Document-tuning for robust alignment to animals
summary: We investigate the robustness of value alignment via finetuning with synthetic documents, using animal compassion as a value that is both important in its own right and orthogonal to existing alignment efforts. To evaluate compassionate reasoning, we develop and publicly release the Animal Harm Benchmark (AHB), a 26-question evaluation spanning 13 ethical dimensions, publicly available as a dataset and Inspect evaluation. On the AHB, training with 3000 documents achieves 77% compared to 40% for instruction-tuning approaches, with generalization to human compassion and no degradation in standard safety benchmarks or capabilities. However, subsequent unrelated instruction-tuning degrades the intervention, with the advantage disappearing after 5000 samples. Our exploratory results suggest document-based value interventions may require explicit preservation strategies to remain effective through typical training pipelines.

AI.tldr: 研究通过合成文档微调实现价值对齐的鲁棒性，以动物同情心为测试案例，发现3000个文档训练能达到77%效果，但后续无关指令微调会削弱干预效果
AI.motivation: 研究价值对齐的鲁棒性问题，特别是通过合成文档微调的方法。选择动物同情心作为测试价值，因为它既重要又与现有对齐工作正交，可以独立评估对齐效果
AI.method: 开发并公开发布动物伤害基准（AHB），包含26个问题覆盖13个伦理维度。使用合成文档进行微调训练，对比指令微调方法，并测试后续无关指令微调对干预效果的影响
AI.result: 3000个文档训练在AHB上达到77%准确率，而指令微调方法只有40%。模型能泛化到人类同情心，且不影响标准安全基准或能力。但后续无关指令微调会削弱干预效果，5000个样本后优势消失
AI.conclusion: 基于文档的价值干预可能需要明确的保护策略，才能在典型训练流程中保持有效。价值对齐的鲁棒性面临挑战，需要专门机制来维持干预效果

title: The Spectrascapes Dataset: Street-view imagery beyond the visible captured using a mobile platform
summary: High-resolution data in spatial and temporal contexts is imperative for developing climate resilient cities. Current datasets for monitoring urban parameters are developed primarily using manual inspections, embedded-sensing, remote sensing, or standard street-view imagery (RGB). These methods and datasets are often constrained respectively by poor scalability, inconsistent spatio-temporal resolutions, overhead views or low spectral information. We present a novel method and its open implementation: a multi-spectral terrestrial-view dataset that circumvents these limitations. This dataset consists of 17,718 street level multi-spectral images captured with RGB, Near-infrared, and Thermal imaging sensors on bikes, across diverse urban morphologies (village, town, small city, and big urban area) in the Netherlands. Strict emphasis is put on data calibration and quality while also providing the details of our data collection methodology (including the hardware and software details). To the best of our knowledge, Spectrascapes is the first open-access dataset of its kind. Finally, we demonstrate two downstream use-cases enabled using this dataset and provide potential research directions in the machine learning, urban planning and remote sensing domains.

AI.tldr: Spectrascapes是一个新颖的多光谱街景数据集，包含17,718张RGB、近红外和热成像图像，覆盖荷兰不同城市形态，用于气候韧性城市研究。
AI.motivation: 现有城市参数监测数据集存在局限性：人工检查可扩展性差，嵌入式传感时空分辨率不一致，遥感提供俯视视角，标准街景图像(RGB)光谱信息有限。需要高分辨率时空数据来开发气候韧性城市。
AI.method: 开发了多光谱地面视角数据集，使用自行车搭载RGB、近红外和热成像传感器采集数据。强调数据校准和质量控制，提供详细的数据收集方法（包括硬件和软件细节）。
AI.result: 创建了包含17,718张多光谱街景图像的数据集，覆盖荷兰不同城市形态（村庄、城镇、小城市和大城市）。这是首个此类开放访问数据集。
AI.conclusion: Spectrascapes数据集克服了现有方法的局限性，展示了两个下游应用案例，为机器学习、城市规划和遥感领域提供了新的研究方向。

title: Why MLLMs Struggle to Determine Object Orientations
summary:
Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) struggle with tasks that require reasoning about 2D object orientation in images, as documented in prior work. Tong et al. and Nichols et al. hypothesize that these failures originate in the visual encoder, since commonly used encoders such as CLIP and SigLIP are trained for image-text semantic alignment rather than geometric reasoning. We design a controlled empirical protocol to test this claim by measuring whether rotations can be recovered from encoder representations. In particular, we examine SigLIP and ViT features from LLaVA OneVision and Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct models, respectively, using full images, and examine CLIP representations in LLaVA 1.5 and 1.6 using rotated foreground patches against natural background images. Our null hypothesis is that orientation information is not preserved in the encoder embeddings and we test this by training linear regressors to predict object orientation from encoded features. Contrary to the hypothesis, we find that orientation information is recoverable from encoder representations: simple linear models accurately predict object orientations from embeddings. This contradicts the assumption that MLLM orientation failures originate in the visual encoder.
  Having rejected the accepted hypothesis that MLLMs struggle with 2D orientation tasks because of visual encoder limitations, we still don't know why they fail. Although a full explanation is beyond the scope of this paper, we show that although present, orientation information is spread diffusely across tens of thousands of features. This may or may not be while MLLMs fail to exploit the available orientation information.

AI.tldr: 研究发现多模态大语言模型在2D物体方向推理任务中的失败并非源于视觉编码器，因为线性回归器可以从编码器特征中准确预测物体方向，但方向信息分散在数万个特征中。
AI.motivation: 先前研究假设多模态大语言模型在2D物体方向推理任务中的失败源于视觉编码器（如CLIP、SigLIP）是为图像-文本语义对齐而非几何推理训练的。本文旨在通过受控实验验证这一假设。
AI.method: 设计了受控实验协议，从编码器表示中测量旋转信息是否可恢复。研究了SigLIP和ViT特征（分别来自LLaVA OneVision和Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct模型），以及CLIP表示（来自LLaVA 1.5和1.6）。通过训练线性回归器从编码特征预测物体方向来测试零假设。
AI.result: 与假设相反，方向信息可以从编码器表示中恢复：简单的线性模型能够从嵌入中准确预测物体方向。这反驳了MLLM方向失败源于视觉编码器的假设。然而，方向信息分散在数万个特征中。
AI.conclusion: MLLM在2D方向任务中的失败并非源于视觉编码器限制，因为方向信息确实存在于编码器表示中。虽然完整解释超出本文范围，但方向信息分散在大量特征中可能是MLLM未能充分利用可用信息的原因之一。

title: Towards Successful Implementation of Automated Raveling Detection: Effects of Training Data Size, Illumination Difference, and Spatial Shift
summary: Raveling, the loss of aggregates, is a major form of asphalt pavement surface distress, especially on highways. While research has shown that machine learning and deep learning-based methods yield promising results for raveling detection by classification on range images, their performance often degrades in large-scale deployments where more diverse inference data may originate from different runs, sensors, and environmental conditions. This degradation highlights the need of a more generalizable and robust solution for real-world implementation. Thus, the objectives of this study are to 1) identify and assess potential variations that impact model robustness, such as the quantity of training data, illumination difference, and spatial shift; and 2) leverage findings to enhance model robustness under real-world conditions. To this end, we propose RavelingArena, a benchmark designed to evaluate model robustness to variations in raveling detection. Instead of collecting extensive new data, it is built by augmenting an existing dataset with diverse, controlled variations, thereby enabling variation-controlled experiments to quantify the impact of each variation. Results demonstrate that both the quantity and diversity of training data are critical to the accuracy of models, achieving at least a 9.2% gain in accuracy under the most diverse conditions in experiments. Additionally, a case study applying these findings to a multi-year test section in Georgia, U.S., shows significant improvements in year-to-year consistency, laying foundations for future studies on temporal deterioration modeling. These insights provide guidance for more reliable model deployment in raveling detection and other real-world tasks that require adaptability to diverse conditions.

AI.tldr: 研究提出RavelingArena基准，通过数据增强评估沥青路面松散检测模型的鲁棒性，发现训练数据量和多样性对模型准确性至关重要，在真实道路测试中显著提升了年际一致性。
AI.motivation: 沥青路面松散是高速公路主要病害，现有机器学习方法在大规模部署时面对不同运行条件、传感器和环境时性能下降，需要更通用和鲁棒的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出RavelingArena基准，通过对现有数据集进行受控变化的数据增强来评估模型鲁棒性，识别影响模型稳健性的关键因素（训练数据量、光照差异、空间偏移）。
AI.result: 训练数据量和多样性对模型准确性至关重要，在最多样化条件下实验准确率至少提升9.2%；在美国乔治亚州多年测试路段案例中，年际一致性显著改善。
AI.conclusion: 研究为松散检测及其他需要适应多样化条件的实际任务提供了更可靠模型部署的指导，为未来时间退化建模研究奠定基础。

title: Unleashing Implicit Rewards: Prefix-Value Learning for Distribution-Level Optimization
summary: Process reward models (PRMs) provide fine-grained reward signals along the reasoning process, but training reliable PRMs often requires step annotations or heavy verification pipelines, making them expensive to scale and refresh during online RL. Implicit PRMs mitigate this cost by learning decomposable token- or step-level rewards from trajectory-level outcome labels. However, they suffer from a train-inference mismatch: training only constrains a sequence-level aggregate, whereas inference requires token-level scores to reflect local step quality. As a result, token-level credits are weakly identified and may fail to faithfully reflect which reasoning steps are actually correct. This unreliability undermines a key promise of implicit PRMs: scoring many candidate tokens. In practice, noisy per-token advantages may systematically reinforce incorrect continuations. We address this problem with a novel Implicit Prefix-Value Reward Model (IPVRM), which directly learns a prefix-conditioned value function estimating the probability of eventual correctness, and derives step signals via temporal-difference (TD) differences. IPVRM substantially improves step-verification F1 on ProcessBench. Building on these calibrated prefix values, we further propose Distribution-Level RL (DistRL), which computes TD advantages for both sampled tokens and high-probability candidate tokens, enabling dense counterfactual updates without additional rollouts. While DistRL offers limited gains when powered by miscalibrated implicit rewards, it consistently improves downstream reasoning once paired with IPVRM.

AI.tldr: 提出IPVRM模型解决隐式过程奖励模型的训练-推理不匹配问题，通过前缀条件价值函数和时序差分改进步骤验证准确性，并基于此开发DistRL进行密集反事实更新。
AI.motivation: 传统过程奖励模型需要步骤标注或复杂验证流程，成本高昂难以扩展。隐式PRMs虽然从轨迹级标签学习，但存在训练-推理不匹配问题：训练只约束序列级聚合，而推理需要反映局部步骤质量的令牌级分数，导致令牌级信用识别弱且不可靠。
AI.method: 提出IPVRM（隐式前缀价值奖励模型），直接学习前缀条件价值函数估计最终正确概率，通过时序差分推导步骤信号。基于校准的前缀值，进一步提出DistRL（分布级强化学习），为采样令牌和高概率候选令牌计算TD优势，实现无需额外rollout的密集反事实更新。
AI.result: IPVRM在ProcessBench上显著提高了步骤验证F1分数。DistRL与IPVRM结合后，能持续改进下游推理性能，而单独使用校准不良的隐式奖励时增益有限。
AI.conclusion: IPVRM通过直接学习前缀条件价值函数解决了隐式PRMs的训练-推理不匹配问题，提供了更可靠的步骤级奖励信号。结合DistRL，能够在无需额外rollout的情况下实现密集的反事实更新，为过程奖励模型的实际应用提供了更高效可靠的解决方案。

title: InfiniteScienceGym: An Unbounded, Procedurally-Generated Benchmark for Scientific Analysis
summary: Large language models are emerging as scientific assistants, but evaluating their ability to reason from empirical data remains challenging. Benchmarks derived from published studies and human annotations inherit publication bias, known-knowledge bias, label noise, and substantial storage requirements. We present InfiniteScienceGym, a procedurally generated benchmark of scientific repositories paired with a verifiable question-answering task. From a seed, the simulator deterministically generates a self-contained repository with realistic directory structure, files, and tabular data, and a privileged QA generator produces both answerable and unanswerable questions with exact ground truth. This makes it possible to evaluate evidence-grounded reasoning, abstention, and tool-mediated analysis in a controlled setting without distributing a large static corpus. InfiniteScienceGym complements real scientific benchmarks by targeting blind spots and failure modes that are hard to evaluate using published datasets alone. Evaluating both proprietary and open-weight models, we find that none achieve more than 45% accuracy overall, that recognizing unanswerable questions remains a major weakness, and that stronger models tend to use tools more effectively rather than simply consuming more tokens.

AI.tldr: InfiniteScienceGym是一个程序生成的科学仓库基准测试，用于评估LLMs基于实证数据的推理能力，避免传统基准的偏见和噪声问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于已发表研究和人工标注的基准测试存在发表偏见、已知知识偏见、标签噪声和存储需求大等问题，难以准确评估LLMs基于实证数据的科学推理能力。
AI.method: 提出InfiniteScienceGym，通过确定性程序生成包含目录结构、文件和表格数据的自包含科学仓库，配合特权QA生成器产生可回答和不可回答的问题及其确切真值。
AI.result: 评估显示专有和开源模型总体准确率均不超过45%，识别不可回答问题仍是主要弱点，更强的模型倾向于更有效地使用工具而非简单消耗更多token。
AI.conclusion: InfiniteScienceGym通过可控环境补充真实科学基准，能够评估证据基础推理、弃权和工具中介分析，揭示传统基准难以评估的盲点和失败模式。

title: SSD-GS: Scattering and Shadow Decomposition for Relightable 3D Gaussian Splatting
comment: Accepted to ICLR 2026. Code available at: https://github.com/irisfreesiri/SSD-GS
summary: We present SSD-GS, a physically-based relighting framework built upon 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) that achieves high-quality reconstruction and photorealistic relighting under novel lighting conditions. In physically-based relighting, accurately modeling light-material interactions is essential for faithful appearance reproduction. However, existing 3DGS-based relighting methods adopt coarse shading decompositions, either modeling only diffuse and specular reflections or relying on neural networks to approximate shadows and scattering. This leads to limited fidelity and poor physical interpretability, particularly for anisotropic metals and translucent materials. To address these limitations, SSD-GS decomposes reflectance into four components: diffuse, specular, shadow, and subsurface scattering. We introduce a learnable dipole-based scattering module for subsurface transport, an occlusion-aware shadow formulation that integrates visibility estimates with a refinement network, and an enhanced specular component with an anisotropic Fresnel-based model. Through progressive integration of all components during training, SSD-GS effectively disentangles lighting and material properties, even for unseen illumination conditions, as demonstrated on the challenging OLAT dataset. Experiments demonstrate superior quantitative and perceptual relighting quality compared to prior methods and pave the way for downstream tasks, including controllable light source editing and interactive scene relighting. The source code is available at: https://github.com/irisfreesiri/SSD-GS.

AI.tldr: SSD-GS是一个基于3D高斯泼溅的物理重光照框架，通过四分量反射分解实现高质量重建和真实感重光照，特别针对各向异性金属和半透明材料。
AI.motivation: 现有3DGS重光照方法采用粗糙的着色分解，要么只建模漫反射和镜面反射，要么依赖神经网络近似阴影和散射，导致保真度有限且物理可解释性差，尤其对各向异性金属和半透明材料效果不佳。
AI.method: 将反射分解为四个分量：漫反射、镜面反射、阴影和次表面散射。引入可学习的偶极子散射模块处理次表面传输，遮挡感知阴影公式结合可见性估计和细化网络，以及增强的基于各向异性菲涅尔模型的镜面反射组件。通过训练期间逐步集成所有组件。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的OLAT数据集上展示了卓越的定量和感知重光照质量，能够有效解耦光照和材质属性，即使在未见光照条件下也能保持高质量。优于现有方法，支持可控光源编辑和交互式场景重光照等下游任务。
AI.conclusion: SSD-GS通过精细的四分量反射分解实现了高质量的物理重光照，解决了现有方法对各向异性金属和半透明材料的局限性，为下游应用提供了强大基础。

title: Evaluating the Evaluator: Problems with SemEval-2020 Task 1 for Lexical Semantic Change Detection
summary: This discussion paper re-examines SemEval-2020 Task 1, the most influential shared benchmark for lexical semantic change detection, through a three-part evaluative framework: operationalisation, data quality, and benchmark design. First, at the level of operationalisation, we argue that the benchmark models semantic change mainly as gain, loss, or redistribution of discrete senses. While practical for annotation and evaluation, this framing is too narrow to capture gradual, constructional, collocational, and discourse-level change. Also, the gold labels are outcomes of annotation decisions, clustering procedures, and threshold settings, which could potentially limit the validity of the task. Second, at the level of data quality, we show that the benchmark is affected by substantial corpus and preprocessing problems, including OCR noise, malformed characters, truncated sentences, inconsistent lemmatisation, POS-tagging errors, and missed targets. These issues can distort model behaviour, complicate linguistic analysis, and reduce reproducibility. Third, at the level of bench-mark design, we argue the small curated target sets and limited language coverage reduce realism and increase statistical uncertainty. Taken together, these limitations suggest that the benchmark should be treated as a useful but partial test bed rather than a definitive measure of progress. We therefore call for future datasets and shared tasks to adopt broader theories of semantic change, document pre-processing transparently, expand cross-linguistic coverage, and use more realistic evaluation settings. Such steps are necessary for more valid, interpretable, and generalisable progress in lexical semantic change detection

AI.tldr: 本文重新评估了SemEval-2020 Task 1这一词汇语义变化检测的权威基准，从操作化、数据质量和基准设计三个层面揭示了其局限性，认为该基准应被视为部分测试平台而非权威衡量标准。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在批判性地重新评估SemEval-2020 Task 1这一词汇语义变化检测领域最具影响力的共享基准，揭示其在理论框架、数据质量和实验设计方面的局限性，以推动该领域向更有效、可解释和可推广的方向发展。
AI.method: 采用三部分评估框架：1) 操作化层面：分析基准如何将语义变化建模为离散义项的获得、丢失或重新分配；2) 数据质量层面：识别语料库和预处理中的问题，包括OCR噪声、字符格式错误、句子截断、词形还原不一致等；3) 基准设计层面：评估目标词集规模小、语言覆盖有限等问题。
AI.result: 研究发现：1) 基准对语义变化的建模过于狭窄，无法捕捉渐进式、构式、搭配和话语层面的变化；2) 数据存在严重质量问题，可能扭曲模型行为、复杂化语言分析并降低可复现性；3) 基准设计存在局限性，小规模目标词集和有限语言覆盖降低了真实性和增加了统计不确定性。
AI.conclusion: SemEval-2020 Task 1应被视为有用但部分的测试平台，而非词汇语义变化检测进展的权威衡量标准。未来研究需要采用更广泛的语义变化理论、透明记录预处理过程、扩展跨语言覆盖，并使用更真实的评估设置，以实现更有效、可解释和可推广的进展。

title: Hessian-Enhanced Token Attribution (HETA): Interpreting Autoregressive LLMs
summary: Attribution methods seek to explain language model predictions by quantifying the contribution of input tokens to generated outputs. However, most existing techniques are designed for encoder-based architectures and rely on linear approximations that fail to capture the causal and semantic complexities of autoregressive generation in decoder-only models. To address these limitations, we propose Hessian-Enhanced Token Attribution (HETA), a novel attribution framework tailored for decoder-only language models. HETA combines three complementary components: a semantic transition vector that captures token-to-token influence across layers, Hessian-based sensitivity scores that model second-order effects, and KL divergence to measure information loss when tokens are masked. This unified design produces context-aware, causally faithful, and semantically grounded attributions. Additionally, we introduce a curated benchmark dataset for systematically evaluating attribution quality in generative settings. Empirical evaluations across multiple models and datasets demonstrate that HETA consistently outperforms existing methods in attribution faithfulness and alignment with human annotations, establishing a new standard for interpretability in autoregressive language models.

AI.tldr: 提出HETA框架，专门为解码器语言模型设计，结合语义转换向量、Hessian敏感度评分和KL散度，在生成任务中提供更忠实、语义更丰富的归因解释。
AI.motivation: 现有归因方法主要针对编码器架构，依赖线性近似，无法捕捉解码器自回归生成中的因果和语义复杂性，需要专门为解码器模型设计的归因框架。
AI.method: 提出Hessian-Enhanced Token Attribution (HETA)框架，包含三个组件：1) 捕捉层间token影响的语义转换向量；2) 建模二阶效应的Hessian敏感度评分；3) 测量token被屏蔽时信息损失的KL散度。
AI.result: 在多个模型和数据集上的实验表明，HETA在归因忠实度和与人工标注对齐方面持续优于现有方法，为自回归语言模型的可解释性设立了新标准。
AI.conclusion: HETA框架为解码器语言模型提供了上下文感知、因果忠实且语义基础的归因方法，并建立了系统评估生成任务归因质量的基准数据集。

title: MSGS: Multispectral 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: We present a multispectral extension to 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) for wavelength-aware view synthesis. Each Gaussian is augmented with spectral radiance, represented via per-band spherical harmonics, and optimized under a dual-loss supervision scheme combining RGB and multispectral signals. To improve rendering fidelity, we perform spectral-to-RGB conversion at the pixel level, allowing richer spectral cues to be retained during optimization. Our method is evaluated on both public and self-captured real-world datasets, demonstrating consistent improvements over the RGB-only 3DGS baseline in terms of image quality and spectral consistency. Notably, it excels in challenging scenes involving translucent materials and anisotropic reflections. The proposed approach maintains the compactness and real-time efficiency of 3DGS while laying the foundation for future integration with physically based shading models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多光谱3D高斯泼溅扩展方法，通过为每个高斯添加光谱辐射度表示，结合RGB和多光谱信号的双重损失监督，在像素级进行光谱到RGB转换，提升了渲染质量和光谱一致性。
AI.motivation: 传统的3D高斯泼溅方法仅基于RGB信号，缺乏对光谱信息的建模能力，在处理半透明材料和各向异性反射等复杂场景时存在局限性。需要扩展3DGS以支持波长感知的视图合成，同时保持其紧凑性和实时效率。
AI.method: 为每个高斯添加光谱辐射度表示，使用每波段球谐函数建模；采用结合RGB和多光谱信号的双重损失监督方案；在像素级进行光谱到RGB转换以保留更丰富的光谱线索；在公共和自采集的真实世界数据集上进行评估。
AI.result: 相比仅使用RGB的3DGS基线，该方法在图像质量和光谱一致性方面均取得一致改进；在涉及半透明材料和各向异性反射的挑战性场景中表现优异；保持了3DGS的紧凑性和实时效率。
AI.conclusion: 提出的多光谱3D高斯泼溅扩展方法有效提升了渲染保真度，为未来与基于物理的着色模型集成奠定了基础，同时保持了原始方法的效率和紧凑性优势。

title: Better and Worse with Scale: How Contextual Entrainment Diverges with Model Size
comment: 16 pages, 11 figures, 6 tables. Accepted to Findings of ACL 2026
summary: Larger language models become simultaneously better and worse at handling contextual information -- better at ignoring false claims, worse at ignoring irrelevant tokens. We formalize this apparent paradox through the first scaling laws for contextual entrainment, the tendency of models to favor tokens that appeared in context regardless of relevance. Analyzing the Cerebras-GPT (111M-13B) and Pythia (410M-12B) model families, we find entrainment follows predictable power-law scaling, but with opposite trends depending on context type: semantic contexts show decreasing entrainment with scale, while non-semantic contexts show increasing entrainment. Concretely, the largest models are four times more resistant to counterfactual misinformation than the smallest, yet simultaneously twice as prone to copying arbitrary tokens. These diverging trends, which replicate across model families, suggest that semantic filtering and mechanical copying are functionally distinct behaviors that scale in opposition -- scaling alone does not resolve context sensitivity, it reshapes it.

AI.tldr: 研究发现语言模型规模扩大时对上下文信息的处理呈现矛盾趋势：对语义上下文（如错误信息）的抵抗性增强，但对非语义上下文（如任意标记）的复制倾向也增强
AI.motivation: 研究动机是解释语言模型规模扩大时出现的矛盾现象——模型在处理上下文信息时既变得更好（更能忽略错误信息）又变得更差（更易复制无关标记），希望通过量化分析来理解这种看似矛盾的行为
AI.method: 通过分析Cerebras-GPT（111M-13B）和Pythia（410M-12B）模型家族，建立上下文吸引（contextual entrainment）的首个缩放定律，研究模型在不同类型上下文（语义vs非语义）中的行为差异
AI.result: 研究发现上下文吸引遵循可预测的幂律缩放，但趋势相反：语义上下文的吸引随规模增大而减小，非语义上下文的吸引随规模增大而增大。最大模型对错误信息的抵抗性是最小模型的4倍，但对任意标记的复制倾向是最小模型的2倍
AI.conclusion: 语义过滤和机械复制是功能上不同的行为，它们以相反的方式随规模缩放。单纯扩大模型规模并不能解决上下文敏感性问题，而是重塑了这种敏感性

title: English is Not All You Need: Systematically Exploring the Role of Multilinguality in LLM Post-Training
summary: Despite the widespread multilingual deployment of large language models, post-training pipelines remain predominantly English-centric, contributing to performance disparities across languages. We present a systematic, controlled study of the interplay between training language coverage, model scale, and task domain, based on 220 supervised fine-tuning runs on parallel translated multilingual data mixtures spanning mathematical reasoning and API calling tasks, with models up to 8B parameters. We find that increasing language coverage during post-training is largely beneficial across tasks and model scales, with low-resource languages benefiting the most and high-resource languages plateauing rather than degrading. Even minimal multilinguality helps: incorporating a single non-English language improves both English performance and cross-lingual generalization, making English-only post-training largely suboptimal. Moreover, at sufficient language diversity, zero-shot cross-lingual transfer can match or exceed the effects of direct language inclusion in a low-diversity setting, although gains remain limited for typologically distant, low-resource languages.

AI.tldr: 多语言后训练研究：增加语言覆盖度对模型性能有益，低资源语言受益最大，高资源语言趋于饱和；即使加入单一非英语语言也能提升英语性能和跨语言泛化能力；足够语言多样性下，零样本跨语言迁移可媲美低多样性下的直接语言包含。
AI.motivation: 当前大型语言模型的后训练流程仍以英语为中心，导致不同语言间的性能差异。需要系统研究训练语言覆盖度、模型规模和任务领域之间的相互作用。
AI.method: 基于220个监督微调实验，使用并行翻译的多语言数据混合，涵盖数学推理和API调用任务，模型参数最高达80亿。系统研究语言覆盖度、模型规模和任务领域的关系。
AI.result: 增加后训练语言覆盖度对任务和模型规模都有益，低资源语言受益最大，高资源语言趋于饱和而非退化；即使加入单一非英语语言也能提升英语性能和跨语言泛化；足够语言多样性下，零样本跨语言迁移可匹配低多样性下的直接语言包含效果。
AI.conclusion: 纯英语后训练是次优选择，增加多语言覆盖度能提升模型性能，特别是对低资源语言；语言多样性足够时，零样本跨语言迁移效果显著，但对类型学距离远、资源匮乏的语言增益有限。

title: UniBlendNet: Unified Global, Multi-Scale, and Region-Adaptive Modeling for Ambient Lighting Normalization
comment: Accepted to CVPR 2026 NTIRE Workshop on New Trends in Image Restoration and Enhancement. 8 pages, 4 figures
summary: Ambient Lighting Normalization (ALN) aims to restore images degraded by complex, spatially varying illumination conditions. Existing methods, such as IFBlend, leverage frequency-domain priors to model illumination variations, but still suffer from limited global context modeling and insufficient spatial adaptivity, leading to suboptimal restoration in challenging regions. In this paper, we propose UniBlendNet, a unified framework for ambient lighting normalization that jointly models global illumination, multi-scale structures, and region-adaptive refinement. Specifically, we enhance global illumination understanding by integrating a UniConvNet-based module to capture long-range dependencies. To better handle complex lighting variations, we introduce a Scale-Aware Aggregation Module (SAAM) that performs pyramid-based multi-scale feature aggregation with dynamic reweighting. Furthermore, we design a mask-guided residual refinement mechanism to enable region-adaptive correction, allowing the model to selectively enhance degraded regions while preserving well-exposed areas. This design effectively improves illumination consistency and structural fidelity under complex lighting conditions. Extensive experiments on the NTIRE Ambient Lighting Normalization benchmark demonstrate that UniBlendNet consistently outperforms the baseline IFBlend and achieves improved restoration quality, while producing visually more natural and stable restoration results.

AI.tldr: UniBlendNet：一种用于环境光照归一化的统一框架，通过联合建模全局光照、多尺度结构和区域自适应细化，在复杂光照条件下实现更好的图像恢复效果。
AI.motivation: 现有方法如IFBlend虽然利用频域先验建模光照变化，但在全局上下文建模和空间适应性方面存在不足，导致在挑战性区域恢复效果欠佳。
AI.method: 提出UniBlendNet统一框架：1）集成UniConvNet模块增强全局光照理解；2）引入尺度感知聚合模块（SAAM）进行金字塔多尺度特征聚合与动态重加权；3）设计掩码引导的残差细化机制实现区域自适应校正。
AI.result: 在NTIRE环境光照归一化基准测试中，UniBlendNet始终优于基线IFBlend，获得更高的恢复质量，产生视觉上更自然、更稳定的恢复结果。
AI.conclusion: UniBlendNet通过联合建模全局光照、多尺度结构和区域自适应细化，有效改善了复杂光照条件下的光照一致性和结构保真度。

title: AgentSPEX: An Agent SPecification and EXecution Language
summary: Language-model agent systems commonly rely on reactive prompting, in which a single instruction guides the model through an open-ended sequence of reasoning and tool-use steps, leaving control flow and intermediate state implicit and making agent behavior potentially difficult to control. Orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, DSPy, and CrewAI impose greater structure through explicit workflow definitions, but tightly couple workflow logic with Python, making agents difficult to maintain and modify. In this paper, we introduce AgentSPEX, an Agent SPecification and EXecution Language for specifying LLM-agent workflows with explicit control flow and modular structure, along with a customizable agent harness. AgentSPEX supports typed steps, branching and loops, parallel execution, reusable submodules, and explicit state management, and these workflows execute within an agent harness that provides tool access, a sandboxed virtual environment, and support for checkpointing, verification, and logging. Furthermore, we provide a visual editor with synchronized graph and workflow views for authoring and inspection. We include ready-to-use agents for deep research and scientific research, and we evaluate AgentSPEX on 7 benchmarks. Finally, we show through a user study that AgentSPEX provides a more interpretable and accessible workflow-authoring paradigm than a popular existing agent framework.

AI.tldr: AgentSPEX是一种用于LLM智能体工作流的规范和执行语言，提供显式控制流和模块化结构，解决现有反应式提示和Python框架的可控性和维护性问题。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型智能体系统依赖反应式提示，控制流和中间状态隐式，难以控制行为；而Orchestration框架如LangGraph、DSPy、CrewAI虽然提供结构，但将工作流逻辑与Python紧密耦合，导致智能体难以维护和修改。
AI.method: 提出AgentSPEX语言，支持类型化步骤、分支循环、并行执行、可重用子模块和显式状态管理；提供可定制的智能体框架，包含工具访问、沙盒虚拟环境、检查点、验证和日志功能；还提供可视化编辑器，支持图形和工作流视图同步。
AI.result: 包含深度研究和科学研究即用智能体，在7个基准测试上评估AgentSPEX；用户研究表明，相比现有流行智能体框架，AgentSPEX提供了更易解释和可访问的工作流编写范式。
AI.conclusion: AgentSPEX通过专门的规范语言和可视化工具，解决了LLM智能体工作流的可控性、可维护性和可解释性问题，为智能体开发提供了更结构化的方法。

title: Why Multimodal In-Context Learning Lags Behind? Unveiling the Inner Mechanisms and Bottlenecks
summary: In-context learning (ICL) enables models to adapt to new tasks via inference-time demonstrations. Despite its success in large language models, the extension of ICL to multimodal settings remains poorly understood in terms of its internal mechanisms and how it differs from text-only ICL. In this work, we conduct a systematic analysis of ICL in multimodal large language models. Using identical task formulations across modalities, we show that multimodal ICL performs comparably to text-only ICL in zero-shot settings but degrades significantly under few-shot demonstrations. To understand this gap, we decompose multimodal ICL into task mapping construction and task mapping transfer, and analyze how models establish cross-modal task mappings, and transfer them to query samples across layers. Our analysis reveals that current models lack reasoning-level alignment between visual and textual representations, and fail to reliably transfer learned task mappings to queries. Guided by these findings, we further propose a simple inference-stage enhancement method that reinforces task mapping transfer. Our results provide new insights into the mechanisms and limitations of multimodal ICL and suggest directions for more effective multimodal adaptation. Our code is available \href{https://github.com/deeplearning-wisc/Multimocal-ICL-Analysis-Framework-MGI}{here}.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统分析了多模态大语言模型中的上下文学习机制，发现多模态ICL在零样本设置下表现与纯文本ICL相当，但在少样本演示下显著退化，揭示了当前模型缺乏视觉与文本表示之间的推理级对齐。
AI.motivation: 尽管上下文学习在大语言模型中取得了成功，但其在多模态环境中的内部机制以及与纯文本ICL的差异仍然缺乏深入理解。研究旨在揭示多模态ICL的工作原理和局限性。
AI.method: 使用跨模态的相同任务形式化，将多模态ICL分解为任务映射构建和任务映射传递两个阶段，分析模型如何建立跨模态任务映射并在各层中将其传递到查询样本。
AI.result: 研究发现当前模型缺乏视觉与文本表示之间的推理级对齐，无法可靠地将学习到的任务映射传递到查询中。基于这些发现，提出了一个简单的推理阶段增强方法来强化任务映射传递。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为多模态ICL的机制和局限性提供了新见解，并指出了更有效的多模态适应方向。提出的增强方法能够改善任务映射传递效果。

title: Peer-Predictive Self-Training for Language Model Reasoning
summary: Mechanisms for continued self-improvement of language models without external supervision remain an open challenge. We propose Peer-Predictive Self-Training (PST), a label-free fine-tuning framework in which multiple language models improve collaboratively by leveraging a cross-model aggregated response as an internal training signal. Given a prompt question, the models generate responses sequentially; the final aggregated answer, often more reliable than individual responses in practice, serves as an internal target for learning. We measure how informative each intermediate response is about the aggregate using pointwise mutual information (PMI), and use this signal to scale self-training updates. Responses already aligned with the aggregate are updated less, while less informative or misaligned responses are updated more. On mathematical reasoning benchmarks (SimulEq, Math500, and MultiArith), PST improves exact-match accuracy by 2.2 to 4.3 percentage points across Gemma-2-2B, LLaMA-3.2-1B, and Qwen-2.5-1.5B, and reduces the average generator-verifier gap (GV-Gap) by 26 to 40 percent, while requiring no external supervision or teacher-student hierarchy and relying solely on cross-model interactions. These results suggest that cross-model generations and peer-predictive feedback can serve as an effective approach for self-supervised training.

AI.tldr: PST是一种无标签微调框架，多个语言模型通过利用跨模型聚合响应作为内部训练信号进行协作式自我改进，无需外部监督。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在没有外部监督的情况下持续自我改进的机制仍然是一个开放挑战，需要探索无监督的自我训练方法。
AI.method: 提出Peer-Predictive Self-Training (PST)框架：多个语言模型顺序生成响应，最终聚合答案作为内部训练目标；使用点互信息(PMI)衡量中间响应与聚合答案的信息量，据此缩放自我训练更新。
AI.result: 在数学推理基准测试(SimulEq、Math500、MultiArith)上，PST将Gemma-2-2B、LLaMA-3.2-1B和Qwen-2.5-1.5B的精确匹配准确率提高了2.2到4.3个百分点，并将平均生成器-验证器差距(GV-Gap)降低了26%到40%。
AI.conclusion: 跨模型生成和同伴预测反馈可以作为有效的自监督训练方法，无需外部监督或师生层次结构，仅依赖跨模型交互。

title: TLoRA+: A Low-Rank Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning Method for Large Language Models
comment: 16 pages, 12 figures and 6 tables in total. Submitted to CoLM
summary: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) aims to adapt pre-trained models to specific tasks using relatively small and domain-specific datasets. Among Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) methods, Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) stands out by matching the performance of full fine-tuning while avoiding additional inference latency. In this paper, we propose a novel PEFT method that incorporates the TLoRA+ optimizer into the weight matrices of pre-trained models. The proposed approach not only preserves the efficiency of low-rank adaptation but also further enhances performance without significantly increasing computational cost. We conduct experiments on the GLUE benchmark across diverse model architectures. Numerical experiments consistently demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of our proposed method.

AI.tldr: 提出一种新的参数高效微调方法，将TLoRA+优化器集成到预训练模型的权重矩阵中，在保持低秩适应效率的同时进一步提升性能
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型微调需要适应特定任务但通常使用较小的领域特定数据集。在参数高效微调方法中，LoRA虽然能匹配全微调性能且不增加推理延迟，但仍有改进空间
AI.method: 提出新颖的参数高效微调方法，将TLoRA+优化器集成到预训练模型的权重矩阵中，在保持低秩适应效率的同时不显著增加计算成本
AI.result: 在GLUE基准测试上对不同模型架构进行实验，数值实验一致证明了所提方法的有效性和鲁棒性
AI.conclusion: 该方法不仅保持了低秩适应的效率，还进一步提升了性能，为大型语言模型的参数高效微调提供了有效解决方案

title: DF3DV-1K: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Distractor-Free Novel View Synthesis
summary: Advances in radiance fields have enabled photorealistic novel view synthesis. In several domains, large-scale real-world datasets have been developed to support comprehensive benchmarking and to facilitate progress beyond scene-specific reconstruction. However, for distractor-free radiance fields, a large-scale dataset with clean and cluttered images per scene remains lacking, limiting the development. To address this gap, we introduce DF3DV-1K, a large-scale real-world dataset comprising 1,048 scenes, each providing clean and cluttered image sets for benchmarking. In total, the dataset contains 89,924 images captured using consumer cameras to mimic casual capture, spanning 128 distractor types and 161 scene themes across indoor and outdoor environments. A curated subset of 41 scenes, DF3DV-41, is systematically designed to evaluate the robustness of distractor-free radiance field methods under challenging scenarios. Using DF3DV-1K, we benchmark nine recent distractor-free radiance field methods and 3D Gaussian Splatting, identifying the most robust methods and the most challenging scenarios. Beyond benchmarking, we demonstrate an application of DF3DV-1K by fine-tuning a diffusion-based 2D enhancer to improve radiance field methods, achieving average improvements of 0.96 dB PSNR and 0.057 LPIPS on the held-out set (e.g., DF3DV-41) and the On-the-go dataset. We hope DF3DV-1K facilitates the development of distractor-free vision and promotes progress beyond scene-specific approaches.

AI.tldr: DF3DV-1K是一个包含1048个场景的大规模真实世界数据集，每个场景提供干净和杂乱图像集，用于无干扰辐射场方法的基准测试和开发。
AI.motivation: 当前缺乏针对无干扰辐射场的大规模数据集，限制了该领域的发展。现有数据集主要关注场景特定重建，而缺少包含干净和杂乱图像对比的大规模基准数据集。
AI.method: 构建了包含1048个场景的DF3DV-1K数据集，每个场景提供干净和杂乱图像集，共包含89,924张图像，涵盖128种干扰类型和161个场景主题。同时创建了DF3DV-41子集用于评估挑战性场景下的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 使用DF3DV-1K对9种无干扰辐射场方法和3D高斯溅射进行基准测试，识别出最鲁棒的方法和最挑战性的场景。通过微调基于扩散的2D增强器，在测试集上实现了平均0.96 dB PSNR和0.057 LPIPS的改进。
AI.conclusion: DF3DV-1K填补了无干扰辐射场领域大规模数据集的空白，为方法开发提供了重要基准，并展示了其在改进辐射场方法方面的应用潜力。

title: Empirical Evidence of Complexity-Induced Limits in Large Language Models on Finite Discrete State-Space Problems with Explicit Validity Constraints
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly described as possessing strong reasoning capabilities, supported by high performance on mathematical, logical, and planning benchmarks. However, most existing evaluations rely on aggregate accuracy over fixed datasets, obscuring how reasoning behavior evolves as task complexity increases. In this work, we introduce a controlled benchmarking framework to systematically evaluate the robustness of reasoning in Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) under progressively increasing problem complexity. We construct a suite of nine classical reasoning tasks: Boolean Satisfiability, Cryptarithmetic, Graph Coloring, River Crossing, Tower of Hanoi, Water Jug, Checker Jumping, Sudoku, and Rubik's Cube, each parameterized to precisely control complexity while preserving underlying semantics. Using deterministic validators, we evaluate multiple open and proprietary LRMs across low, intermediate, and high complexity regimes, ensuring that only fully valid solutions are accepted. Our results reveal a consistent phase transition like behavior: models achieve high accuracy at low complexity but degrade sharply beyond task specific complexity thresholds. We formalize this phenomenon as reasoning collapse. Across tasks, we observe substantial accuracy declines, often exceeding 50%, accompanied by inconsistent reasoning traces, constraint violations, loss of state tracking, and confidently incorrect outputs. Increased reasoning length does not reliably improve correctness, and gains in one problem family do not generalize to others. These findings highlight the need for evaluation methodologies that move beyond static benchmarks and explicitly measure reasoning robustness under controlled complexity.

AI.tldr: 研究发现大型推理模型在低复杂度任务上表现良好，但随着任务复杂度增加会出现"推理崩溃"现象，准确率急剧下降，揭示了当前模型推理能力的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有评估主要依赖固定数据集的聚合准确率，掩盖了推理行为随任务复杂度增加的变化。需要系统评估大型推理模型在不同复杂度下的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 构建包含9个经典推理任务的基准框架（布尔可满足性、密码算术、图着色等），每个任务参数化以精确控制复杂度，使用确定性验证器评估多个开源和专有模型。
AI.result: 发现一致的相变行为：模型在低复杂度下准确率高，但超过任务特定复杂度阈值后急剧下降（通常超过50%），出现不一致推理轨迹、约束违反、状态跟踪丢失和自信的错误输出。
AI.conclusion: 需要超越静态基准的评估方法，在受控复杂度下明确测量推理鲁棒性。推理长度增加不能可靠提高正确性，一个任务族的改进不能推广到其他任务。

title: Physically-Guided Optical Inversion Enable Non-Contact Side-Channel Attack on Isolated Screens
summary: Noncontact exfiltration of electronic screen content poses a security challenge, with side-channel incursions as the principal vector. We introduce an optical projection side-channel paradigm that confronts two core instabilities: (i) the near-singular Jacobian spectrum of projection mapping breaches Hadamard stability, rendering inversion hypersensitive to perturbations; (ii) irreversible compression in light transport obliterates global semantic cues, magnifying reconstruction ambiguity. Exploiting passive speckle patterns formed by diffuse reflection, our Irradiance Robust Radiometric Inversion Network (IR4Net) fuses a Physically Regularized Irradiance Approximation (PRIrr-Approximation), which embeds the radiative transfer equation in a learnable optimizer, with a contour-to-detail cross-scale reconstruction mechanism that arrests noise propagation. Moreover, an Irreversibility Constrained Semantic Reprojection (ICSR) module reinstates lost global structure through context-driven semantic mapping. Evaluated across four scene categories, IR4Net achieves fidelity beyond competing neural approaches while retaining resilience to illumination perturbations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IR4Net网络，利用被动散斑模式解决电子屏幕内容非接触窃取的安全挑战，通过物理正则化辐照度近似和轮廓到细节跨尺度重建机制，在光照扰动下实现高保真重建。
AI.motivation: 电子屏幕内容的非接触窃取是一个安全挑战，光学投影侧信道存在两个核心不稳定性：投影映射的近似奇异雅可比谱违反Hadamard稳定性，使反演对扰动高度敏感；光传输中的不可逆压缩破坏了全局语义线索，放大了重建模糊性。
AI.method: 提出IR4Net网络，利用漫反射形成的被动散斑模式，融合物理正则化辐照度近似（将辐射传输方程嵌入可学习优化器）和轮廓到细节跨尺度重建机制来抑制噪声传播。此外，不可逆约束语义重投影模块通过上下文驱动的语义映射恢复丢失的全局结构。
AI.result: 在四个场景类别上进行评估，IR4Net实现了超越竞争神经方法的重建保真度，同时保持对光照扰动的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: IR4Net通过物理正则化和语义重投影机制，有效解决了光学投影侧信道中的稳定性和不可逆性问题，为电子屏幕内容的安全防护提供了新的技术方案。

title: From Prediction to Justification: Aligning Sentiment Reasoning with Human Rationale via Reinforcement Learning
summary: While Aspect-based Sentiment Analysis (ABSA) systems have achieved high accuracy in identifying sentiment polarities, they often operate as "black boxes," lacking the explicit reasoning capabilities characteristic of human affective cognition. Humans do not merely categorize sentiment; they construct causal explanations for their judgments. To bridge this gap, we propose ABSA-R1, a large language model framework designed to mimic this ``reason-before-predict" cognitive process. By leveraging reinforcement learning (RL), ABSA-R1 learns to articulate the why behind the what, generating natural language justifications that ground its sentiment predictions. We introduce a Cognition-Aligned Reward Model (formerly sentiment-aware reward model) that enforces consistency between the generated reasoning path and the final emotional label. Furthermore, inspired by metacognitive monitoring, we implement a performance-driven rejection sampling strategy that selectively targets hard cases where the model's internal reasoning is uncertain or inconsistent. Experimental results on four benchmarks demonstrate that equipping models with this explicit reasoning capability not only enhances interpretability but also yields superior performance in sentiment classification and triplet extraction compared to non-reasoning baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出ABSA-R1框架，通过强化学习让模型在预测前生成自然语言推理，模仿人类"先推理后预测"的认知过程，提升可解释性和性能。
AI.motivation: 当前ABSA系统虽然准确率高，但缺乏人类情感认知中的显式推理能力。人类不仅分类情感，还会构建因果解释。需要弥补这一差距。
AI.method: 提出ABSA-R1框架，使用强化学习让模型生成自然语言推理。引入认知对齐奖励模型确保推理路径与情感标签一致，并采用性能驱动的拒绝采样策略处理困难案例。
AI.result: 在四个基准测试上，具备显式推理能力的模型不仅增强了可解释性，在情感分类和三元组提取任务上也优于非推理基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过模仿人类"先推理后预测"的认知过程，ABSA-R1框架成功提升了ABSA系统的可解释性和性能，为构建更接近人类认知的AI系统提供了新思路。

title: VibeFlow: Versatile Video Chroma-Lux Editing through Self-Supervised Learning
summary: Video chroma-lux editing, which aims to modify illumination and color while preserving structural and temporal fidelity, remains a significant challenge. Existing methods typically rely on expensive supervised training with synthetic paired data. This paper proposes VibeFlow, a novel self-supervised framework that unleashes the intrinsic physical understanding of pre-trained video generation models. Instead of learning color and light transitions from scratch, we introduce a disentangled data perturbation pipeline that enforces the model to adaptively recombine structure from source videos and color-illumination cues from reference images, enabling robust disentanglement in a self-supervised manner. Furthermore, to rectify discretization errors inherent in flow-based models, we introduce Residual Velocity Fields alongside a Structural Distortion Consistency Regularization, ensuring rigorous structural preservation and temporal coherence. Our framework eliminates the need for costly training resources and generalizes in a zero-shot manner to diverse applications, including video relighting, recoloring, low-light enhancement, day-night translation, and object-specific color editing. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VibeFlow achieves impressive visual quality with significantly reduced computational overhead. Our project is publicly available at https://lyf1212.github.io/VibeFlow-webpage.

AI.tldr: VibeFlow是一个自监督的视频色彩-光照编辑框架，利用预训练视频生成模型的物理理解能力，通过解耦数据扰动实现源视频结构与参考图像色彩-光照线索的自适应重组，无需昂贵的监督训练。
AI.motivation: 视频色彩-光照编辑在保持结构和时间一致性的同时修改光照和颜色是一个重要挑战。现有方法通常依赖昂贵的监督训练和合成配对数据，需要大量计算资源。
AI.method: 提出自监督框架VibeFlow，利用预训练视频生成模型的物理理解能力；引入解耦数据扰动管道，使模型自适应重组源视频结构和参考图像色彩-光照线索；提出残差速度场和结构失真一致性正则化来纠正基于流模型的离散化误差。
AI.result: VibeFlow实现了零样本泛化到多种应用，包括视频重光照、重新着色、低光增强、日夜转换和对象特定颜色编辑。实验表明该方法在显著减少计算开销的同时获得令人印象深刻的视觉质量。
AI.conclusion: VibeFlow提供了一个高效的自监督解决方案，消除了对昂贵训练资源的需求，在保持结构完整性和时间一致性的同时实现了高质量的视频色彩-光照编辑。

title: MERRIN: A Benchmark for Multimodal Evidence Retrieval and Reasoning in Noisy Web Environments
comment: First three authors contributed equally. Project Page: https://merrin-benchmark.github.io/
summary: Motivated by the underspecified, multi-hop nature of search queries and the multimodal, heterogeneous, and often conflicting nature of real-world web results, we introduce MERRIN (Multimodal Evidence Retrieval and Reasoning in Noisy Web Environments), a human-annotated benchmark for evaluating search-augmented agents. MERRIN measures AI agents' ability to identify relevant modalities, retrieve multimodal evidence, and perform multi-hop reasoning over noisy web sources. It differs from prior work in three important aspects: (1) using natural language queries without explicit modality cues, (2) incorporating underexplored modalities such as video and audio, and (3) requiring the retrieval of complex, often noisy or conflicting multimodal evidence during web search. We evaluate diverse search agents powered by ten models, including strong closed-source models (e.g., GPT-5.4-mini, Gemini 3/3.1 Flash/Pro) and open-weight models (Qwen3-4B/30B/235B), across three search settings (no search, native search, and agentic search). Our results show that MERRIN is highly challenging: the average accuracy across all agents is 22.3%, with the best-performing agent reaching only 40.1%. We further observe that while stronger agents like Gemini Deep Research achieve higher performance, gains are modest due to over-exploration; they take more steps and use more tools, but are often distracted by conflicting or partially relevant web content, leading to incorrect answers. Compared to humans, these agents consume more resources yet achieve lower accuracy, largely due to inefficient source selection and an overreliance on text modalities. These findings highlight the need for search agents capable of robust search and reasoning across diverse modalities in noisy web environments, making MERRIN a valuable testbed for evaluating such capabilities.

AI.tldr: MERRIN是一个用于评估搜索增强AI代理的多模态基准测试，要求代理在嘈杂网络环境中识别相关模态、检索多模态证据并进行多跳推理，现有模型表现不佳（平均准确率22.3%）。
AI.motivation: 现实网络搜索查询具有未明确指定、多跳的特性，而网络结果具有多模态、异构且经常相互冲突的特点，需要评估AI代理在这种复杂环境中的搜索和推理能力。
AI.method: 创建MERRIN基准测试，包含自然语言查询（无明确模态提示）、包含视频和音频等未充分探索的模态、要求检索复杂且经常嘈杂或冲突的多模态证据。评估了10个模型驱动的搜索代理，包括闭源模型和开源模型，在三种搜索设置下进行测试。
AI.result: MERRIN极具挑战性：所有代理的平均准确率为22.3%，表现最佳的代理仅达到40.1%。更强的代理如Gemini Deep Research性能更高但提升有限，它们采取更多步骤和使用更多工具，但经常被冲突或部分相关的网络内容分散注意力。与人类相比，这些代理消耗更多资源但准确率更低。
AI.conclusion: 现有搜索代理在嘈杂网络环境中跨多模态进行稳健搜索和推理的能力不足，MERRIN为评估此类能力提供了有价值的测试平台，突显了开发更强大搜索代理的需求。

title: Event-Adaptive State Transition and Gated Fusion for RGB-Event Object Tracking
summary: Existing Vision Mamba-based RGB-Event(RGBE) tracking methods suffer from using static state transition matrices, which fail to adapt to variations in event sparsity. This rigidity leads to imbalanced modeling-underfitting sparse event streams and overfitting dense ones-thus degrading cross-modal fusion robustness. To address these limitations, we propose MambaTrack, a multimodal and efficient tracking framework built upon a Dynamic State Space Model(DSSM). Our contributions are twofold. First, we introduce an event-adaptive state transition mechanism that dynamically modulates the state transition matrix based on event stream density. A learnable scalar governs the state evolution rate, enabling differentiated modeling of sparse and dense event flows. Second, we develop a Gated Projection Fusion(GPF) module for robust cross-modal integration. This module projects RGB features into the event feature space and generates adaptive gates from event density and RGB confidence scores. These gates precisely control the fusion intensity, suppressing noise while preserving complementary information. Experiments show that MambaTrack achieves state-of-the-art performance on the FE108 and FELT datasets. Its lightweight design suggests potential for real-time embedded deployment.

AI.tldr: MambaTrack：基于动态状态空间模型的多模态跟踪框架，通过事件自适应状态转移机制和门控投影融合模块解决现有RGB-事件跟踪方法中静态状态转移矩阵导致的建模不平衡问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于Vision Mamba的RGB-事件跟踪方法使用静态状态转移矩阵，无法适应事件稀疏性的变化，导致对稀疏事件流建模不足、对密集事件流过拟合，从而降低跨模态融合的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 1. 事件自适应状态转移机制：根据事件流密度动态调制状态转移矩阵，通过可学习标量控制状态演化速率，实现对稀疏和密集事件流的差异化建模。2. 门控投影融合模块：将RGB特征投影到事件特征空间，从事件密度和RGB置信度生成自适应门控，精确控制融合强度，抑制噪声同时保留互补信息。
AI.result: 在FE108和FELT数据集上实现了最先进的性能，轻量级设计表明具有实时嵌入式部署的潜力。
AI.conclusion: MambaTrack通过动态状态空间模型解决了RGB-事件跟踪中的模态不平衡问题，事件自适应状态转移和门控投影融合机制显著提升了跨模态融合的鲁棒性和跟踪性能。

title: CANVAS: Continuity-Aware Narratives via Visual Agentic Storyboarding
summary: Long-form visual storytelling requires maintaining continuity across shots, including consistent characters, stable environments, and smooth scene transitions. While existing generative models can produce strong individual frames, they fail to preserve such continuity, leading to appearance changes, inconsistent backgrounds, and abrupt scene shifts. We introduce CANVAS (Continuity-Aware Narratives via Visual Agentic Storyboarding), a multi-agent framework that explicitly plans visual continuity in multi-shot narratives. CANVAS enforces coherence through character continuity, persistent background anchors, and location-aware scene planning for smooth transitions within the same setting We evaluate CANVAS on two storyboard generation benchmarks ST-BENCH and ViStoryBench and introduce a new challenging benchmark HardContinuityBench for long-range narrative consistency. CANVAS consistently outperforms the best-performing baseline, improving background continuity by 21.6%, character consistency by 9.6% and props consistency by 7.6%.

AI.tldr: CANVAS是一个多智能体框架，通过显式规划视觉连续性来解决长视频叙事中的一致性问题，在多个基准测试中显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有生成模型虽然能产生单个优质帧，但无法保持跨镜头连续性，导致角色外观变化、背景不一致和场景转换突兀等问题。
AI.method: 引入CANVAS多智能体框架，通过角色连续性、持久背景锚点和位置感知场景规划来强制保持视觉连贯性。
AI.result: 在ST-BENCH、ViStoryBench和新提出的HardContinuityBench基准测试中，CANVAS持续优于最佳基线方法，背景连续性提升21.6%，角色一致性提升9.6%，道具一致性提升7.6%。
AI.conclusion: CANVAS通过显式规划视觉连续性，有效解决了长视频叙事中的一致性问题，在多镜头故事板生成任务中表现出色。

title: MaMe & MaRe: Matrix-Based Token Merging and Restoration for Efficient Visual Perception and Synthesis
comment: 20 pages. Extended version of CVPR 2026 Findings paper. Neurocomputing (Elsevier) under review
summary: Token compression is crucial for mitigating the quadratic complexity of self-attention mechanisms in Vision Transformers (ViTs), which often involve numerous input tokens. Existing methods, such as ToMe, rely on GPU-inefficient operations (e.g., sorting, scattered writes), introducing overheads that limit their effectiveness. We introduce MaMe, a training-free, differentiable token merging method based entirely on matrix operations, which is GPU-friendly to accelerate ViTs. Additionally, we present MaRe, its inverse operation, for token restoration, forming a MaMe+MaRe pipeline for image synthesis. When applied to pre-trained models, MaMe doubles ViT-B throughput with a 2% accuracy drop. Notably, fine-tuning the last layer with MaMe boosts ViT-B accuracy by 1.0% at 1.1x speed. In SigLIP2-B@512 zero-shot classification, MaMe provides 1.3x acceleration with negligible performance degradation. In video tasks, MaMe accelerates VideoMAE-L by 48.5% on Kinetics-400 with only a 0.84% accuracy loss. Furthermore, MaMe achieves simultaneous improvements in both performance and speed on some tasks. In image synthesis, the MaMe+MaRe pipeline enhances quality while reducing Stable Diffusion v2.1 generation latency by 31%. Collectively, these results demonstrate MaMe's and MaRe's effectiveness in accelerating vision models. The code is available at https://github.com/cominder/mame}{https://github.com/cominder/mame.

AI.tldr: MaMe是一种基于纯矩阵运算的训练免费、可微分的token合并方法，用于加速Vision Transformers。配合其逆操作MaRe，形成图像合成管道，在多种视觉任务中实现显著加速且性能损失极小。
AI.motivation: Vision Transformers中的自注意力机制具有二次复杂度，需要处理大量输入token。现有token压缩方法（如ToMe）依赖GPU效率低下的操作（排序、分散写入），引入额外开销限制了其有效性。
AI.method: 提出MaMe方法，完全基于矩阵运算的训练免费、可微分token合并方法，GPU友好。同时提出其逆操作MaRe用于token恢复，形成MaMe+MaRe管道用于图像合成。
AI.result: 在预训练模型上，MaMe使ViT-B吞吐量翻倍，仅损失2%准确率。微调最后一层后，ViT-B准确率提升1.0%，速度提升1.1倍。在SigLIP2-B@512零样本分类中实现1.3倍加速，性能损失可忽略。在视频任务中，VideoMAE-L加速48.5%，准确率仅损失0.84%。某些任务中同时实现性能和速度提升。图像合成中，MaMe+MaRe管道提升质量同时减少Stable Diffusion v2.1生成延迟31%。
AI.conclusion: MaMe和MaRe方法在加速视觉模型方面表现出色，通过纯矩阵运算的GPU友好设计，在多种视觉任务中实现显著加速且保持高性能。

title: A Study of Failure Modes in Two-Stage Human-Object Interaction Detection
comment: Accepted to SAUAFG Workshop at CVPR 2026
summary: Human-object interaction (HOI) detection aims to detect interactions between humans and objects in images. While recent advances have improved performance on existing benchmarks, their evaluations mainly focus on overall prediction accuracy and provide limited insight into the underlying causes of model failures. In particular, modern models often struggle in complex scenes involving multiple people and rare interaction combinations. In this work, we present a study to better understand the failure modes of two-stage HOI models, which form the basis of many current HOI detection approaches. Rather than constructing a large-scale benchmark, we instead decompose HOI detection into multiple interpretable perspectives and analyze model behavior across these dimensions to study different types of failure patterns. We curate a subset of images from an existing HOI dataset organized by human-object-interaction configurations (e.g., multi-person interactions and object sharing), and analyze model behavior under these configurations to examine different failure modes. This design allows us to analyze how these HOI models behave under different scene compositions and why their predictions fail. Importantly, high overall benchmark performance does not necessarily reflect robust visual reasoning about human-object relationships. We hope that this study can provide useful insights into the limitations of HOI models and offer observations for future research in this area.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了两阶段人-物交互检测模型的失败模式，通过将HOI检测分解为多个可解释维度，在特定场景配置下分析模型行为，发现高基准性能不一定代表对人-物关系的稳健视觉推理能力。
AI.motivation: 当前HOI检测模型虽然在基准测试上表现良好，但主要关注整体预测准确率，对模型失败的根本原因缺乏深入理解。特别是现代模型在处理涉及多人和罕见交互组合的复杂场景时经常遇到困难。需要更好地理解HOI模型的失败模式，以提供对未来研究有用的见解。
AI.method: 研究将HOI检测分解为多个可解释的视角，分析模型在这些维度上的行为。从现有HOI数据集中策划了一个按人-物-交互配置组织的图像子集，分析模型在这些配置下的行为以检查不同的失败模式。重点关注多人物交互和物体共享等复杂场景配置。
AI.result: 研究发现高整体基准性能不一定反映对人-物关系的稳健视觉推理能力。通过分析模型在不同场景配置下的行为，揭示了各种失败模式，特别是在复杂场景中的表现问题。
AI.conclusion: 这项研究为理解HOI模型的局限性提供了有价值的见解，强调需要超越整体基准性能的评估，关注模型在复杂场景中的实际推理能力。研究结果为该领域的未来研究提供了观察和建议。

title: ToolSpec: Accelerating Tool Calling via Schema-Aware and Retrieval-Augmented Speculative Decoding
summary: Tool calling has greatly expanded the practical utility of large language models (LLMs) by enabling them to interact with external applications. As LLM capabilities advance, effective tool use increasingly involves multi-step, multi-turn interactions to solve complex tasks. However, the resulting growth in tool interactions incurs substantial latency, posing a key challenge for real-time LLM serving. Through empirical analysis, we find that tool-calling traces are highly structured, conform to constrained schemas, and often exhibit recurring invocation patterns. Motivated by this, we propose ToolSpec, a schema-aware, retrieval-augmented speculative decoding method for accelerating tool calling. ToolSpec exploits predefined tool schemas to generate accurate drafts, using a finite-state machine to alternate between deterministic schema token filling and speculative generation for variable fields. In addition, ToolSpec retrieves similar historical tool invocations and reuses them as drafts to further improve efficiency. ToolSpec presents a plug-and-play solution that can be seamlessly integrated into existing LLM workflows. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that ToolSpec achieves up to a 4.2x speedup, substantially outperforming existing training-free speculative decoding methods.

AI.tldr: ToolSpec：一种基于模式感知、检索增强的推测解码方法，通过利用预定义工具模式和历史调用记录来加速LLM工具调用，实现最高4.2倍加速
AI.motivation: 随着LLM能力提升，复杂任务需要多步骤、多轮次的工具调用，导致延迟显著增加，成为实时LLM服务的关键挑战。研究发现工具调用轨迹具有高度结构化、符合约束模式且常出现重复调用模式的特点
AI.method: 提出ToolSpec方法：1）利用预定义工具模式生成准确草稿，使用有限状态机在确定性模式令牌填充和可变字段推测生成之间切换；2）检索相似历史工具调用并复用为草稿；3）提供即插即用方案，可无缝集成到现有LLM工作流
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中，ToolSpec实现了最高4.2倍的加速效果，显著优于现有的无需训练的推测解码方法
AI.conclusion: ToolSpec通过利用工具调用的结构特性和历史模式，有效解决了LLM工具调用延迟问题，为实时LLM服务提供了高效的加速方案

title: Enhanced Text-to-Image Generation by Fine-grained Multimodal Reasoning
summary: With the rapid progress of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), unified MLLMs that jointly perform image understanding and generation have advanced significantly. However, despite the inherent reasoning capabilities of unified MLLMs for self-reflection and self-refinement, their use in text-to-image generation remains largely underexplored. Meanwhile, existing multimodal reasoning-based image generation methods mostly rely on holistic image-text alignment judgments, without fine-grained reflection and refinement of detailed prompt attributes, leading to limited fine-grained control. Therefore, we propose Fine-grained Multimodal Reasoning (FiMR), a framework that leverages decomposed visual question answering (VQA) to break down an input prompt into minimal semantic units-such as entities and attributes-and verify each unit via VQA to generate explicit, fine-grained feedback. Based on this feedback, FiMR then applies targeted, localized refinements. This fine-grained self-reasoning and self-refinement enable MLLMs to achieve more precise improvements in image-prompt alignment and overall generation quality at test time. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FiMR consistently outperforms image generation baselines, including reasoning-based methods, particularly on compositional text-to-image benchmarks.

AI.tldr: FiMR框架利用多模态大语言模型的推理能力，通过分解视觉问答实现细粒度自反思和自优化，提升文本到图像生成的精细控制能力
AI.motivation: 当前统一多模态大语言模型在图像生成中未充分利用其推理能力进行自反思和自优化，现有方法主要依赖整体图像-文本对齐判断，缺乏对详细提示属性的细粒度反思和优化，导致精细控制能力有限
AI.method: 提出细粒度多模态推理框架FiMR，通过分解视觉问答将输入提示分解为最小语义单元（如实体和属性），通过VQA验证每个单元生成明确的细粒度反馈，然后基于反馈进行有针对性的局部优化
AI.result: 大量实验表明，FiMR在图像生成基准测试中持续优于包括基于推理方法在内的基线方法，特别是在组合文本到图像基准测试上表现突出
AI.conclusion: FiMR框架通过细粒度自推理和自优化，使多模态大语言模型能够在测试时实现更精确的图像-提示对齐和整体生成质量改进

title: Synthesizing Instruction-Tuning Datasets with Contrastive Decoding
summary: Using responses generated by high-performing large language models (LLMs) for instruction tuning has become a widely adopted approach. However, the existing literature overlooks a property of LLM-generated responses: they conflate world knowledge acquired during pre-training with instruction-following capabilities acquired during post-training. We hypothesize that disentangling the instruction-following capabilities from pre-trained knowledge improves the effectiveness of instruction tuning. To this end, we propose CoDIT, a method that applies contrastive decoding between a post-trained model and its pre-trained counterpart during response generation. The method suppresses pre-trained knowledge shared between the two models while amplifying the instruction-following behavior acquired via post-training, resulting in responses that more purely reflect instruction-following capabilities. Experiment results demonstrate that models trained on datasets constructed via CoDIT consistently outperform those trained on directly generated responses. Training on our datasets also yields better performance than on existing publicly available instruction-tuning datasets across multiple benchmarks. Furthermore, we theoretically and empirically show that CoDIT can be interpreted as distilling the chat vector from parameter space to text space, enabling the transfer of instruction-tuning capabilities across models of different architectures.

AI.tldr: CoDIT提出了一种通过对比解码分离预训练知识和指令跟随能力的指令调优方法，能生成更纯粹的指令跟随响应，提升模型性能
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM生成响应的指令调优方法存在一个问题：LLM生成的响应将预训练获得的世界知识与后训练获得的指令跟随能力混在一起。作者假设将指令跟随能力与预训练知识分离能提高指令调优的效果。
AI.method: 提出CoDIT方法，在后训练模型和其预训练对应模型之间应用对比解码来生成响应。该方法抑制两个模型共享的预训练知识，同时放大后训练获得的指令跟随行为，从而生成更纯粹反映指令跟随能力的响应。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，使用CoDIT构建的数据集训练的模型在多个基准测试中表现优于直接生成响应训练的模型，也优于现有公开指令调优数据集训练的模型。理论上和实证上都表明CoDIT可以将指令跟随能力从参数空间蒸馏到文本空间，实现跨架构模型的指令调优能力迁移。
AI.conclusion: CoDIT通过对比解码有效分离预训练知识和指令跟随能力，生成更优质的指令调优数据，提升模型性能，并能实现指令跟随能力的跨模型迁移。

title: Debate to Align: Reliable Entity Alignment through Two-Stage Multi-Agent Debate
summary: Entity alignment (EA) aims to identify entities referring to the same real-world object across different knowledge graphs (KGs). Recent approaches based on large language models (LLMs) typically obtain entity embeddings through knowledge representation learning and use embedding similarity to identify an alignment-uncertain entity set. For each uncertain entity, a candidate entity set (CES) is then retrieved based on embedding similarity to support subsequent alignment reasoning and decision making. However, the reliability of the CES and the reasoning capability of LLMs critically affect the effectiveness of subsequent alignment decisions. To address this issue, we propose AgentEA, a reliable EA framework based on multi-agent debate. AgentEA first improves embedding quality through entity representation preference optimization, and then introduces a two-stage multi-role debate mechanism consisting of lightweight debate verification and deep debate alignment to progressively enhance the reliability of alignment decisions while enabling more efficient debate-based reasoning. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks under cross-lingual, sparse, large-scale, and heterogeneous settings demonstrate the effectiveness of AgentEA.

AI.tldr: 提出AgentEA框架，通过多智能体辩论机制提升知识图谱实体对齐的可靠性，包含表示偏好优化和两阶段辩论验证
AI.motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的实体对齐方法存在两个关键问题：候选实体集的可靠性不足，以及LLMs的推理能力有限，这影响了后续对齐决策的有效性
AI.method: AgentEA框架包含两个主要部分：1) 通过实体表示偏好优化提升嵌入质量；2) 引入两阶段多角色辩论机制，包括轻量级辩论验证和深度辩论对齐，逐步增强对齐决策的可靠性
AI.result: 在跨语言、稀疏、大规模和异构设置下的公共基准测试中进行了广泛实验，证明了AgentEA的有效性
AI.conclusion: AgentEA通过多智能体辩论机制解决了实体对齐中候选实体集可靠性和推理能力的瓶颈问题，显著提升了实体对齐的性能

title: Enhancing Mixture-of-Experts Specialization via Cluster-Aware Upcycling
comment: Comments: Accepted to CVPR 2026. Project page: https://sanghyeokchu.github.io/cluster-aware-upcycling/
summary: Sparse Upcycling provides an efficient way to initialize a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model from pretrained dense weights instead of training from scratch. However, since all experts start from identical weights and the router is randomly initialized, the model suffers from expert symmetry and limited early specialization. We propose Cluster-aware Upcycling, a strategy that incorporates semantic structure into MoE initialization. Our method first partitions the dense model's input activations into semantic clusters. Each expert is then initialized using the subspace representations of its corresponding cluster via truncated SVD, while setting the router's initial weights to the cluster centroids. This cluster-aware initialization breaks expert symmetry and encourages early specialization aligned with the data distribution. Furthermore, we introduce an expert-ensemble self-distillation loss that stabilizes training by providing reliable routing guidance using an ensemble teacher. When evaluated on CLIP ViT-B/32 and ViT-B/16, Cluster-aware Upcycling consistently outperforms existing methods across both zero-shot and few-shot benchmarks. The proposed method also produces more diverse and disentangled expert representations, reduces inter-expert similarity, and leads to more confident routing behavior.
