Consequently, we abstract away from these representation differences and instead focus on model design, proposing a novel taxonomy centered on model design strategies that are agnostic to the output format. Our proposed taxonomy organizes the research directions into five key problems that drive recent research development: feature enhancement, geometry awareness, model efficiency, augmentation strategies and temporal-aware models. To support this taxonomy with empirical grounding and standardized evaluation, we further comprehensively review related benchmarks and datasets, and extensively discuss and categorize real-world applications based on feed-forward 3D models. Finally, we outline future directions to address open challenges such as scalability, evaluation standards, and world modeling.

AI.tldr: 这篇综述论文提出了一种基于模型设计策略的新颖分类法，用于组织可泛化的前馈式3D重建研究，重点关注特征增强、几何感知、模型效率、增强策略和时序感知模型五个关键问题。
AI.motivation: 传统3D重建方法存在每场景优化缓慢或类别特定训练的限制，阻碍了实际部署和可扩展性。尽管现有前馈方法使用不同的几何输出表示（从隐式场到显式基元），但它们共享相似的高级架构模式，因此需要一种独立于输出格式的模型设计分类法。
AI.method: 提出一种新颖的分类法，抽象掉表示差异，专注于模型设计策略。该分类法将研究方向组织为五个关键问题：特征增强、几何感知、模型效率、增强策略和时序感知模型。同时全面回顾相关基准测试和数据集，并基于前馈3D模型对实际应用进行分类讨论。
AI.result: 建立了一个系统化的分类框架，能够统一分析不同输出表示的前馈3D重建方法。通过实证基础和标准化评估支持该分类法，为领域研究提供了清晰的组织结构和未来发展方向。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为可泛化的前馈式3D重建领域提供了新的视角，通过模型设计中心的分类法促进了跨表示方法的比较和分析。未来需要解决可扩展性、评估标准和世界建模等开放挑战。

title: UI-Zoomer: Uncertainty-Driven Adaptive Zoom-In for GUI Grounding
summary: GUI grounding, which localizes interface elements from screenshots given natural language queries, remains challenging for small icons and dense layouts. Test-time zoom-in methods improve localization by cropping and re-running inference at higher resolution, but apply cropping uniformly across all instances with fixed crop sizes, ignoring whether the model is actually uncertain on each case. We propose \textbf{UI-Zoomer}, a training-free adaptive zoom-in framework that treats both the trigger and scale of zoom-in as a prediction uncertainty quantification problem. A confidence-aware gate fuses spatial consensus among stochastic candidates with token-level generation confidence to selectively trigger zoom-in only when localization is uncertain. When triggered, an uncertainty-driven crop sizing module decomposes prediction variance into inter-sample positional spread and intra-sample box extent, deriving a per-instance crop radius via the law of total variance. Extensive experiments on ScreenSpot-Pro, UI-Vision, and ScreenSpot-v2 demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines across multiple model architectures, achieving gains of up to +13.4\%, +10.3\%, and +4.2\% respectively, with no additional training required.

AI.tldr: UI-Zoomer：一种无需训练的自适应放大框架，通过预测不确定性量化来智能触发和调整放大操作，提升GUI元素定位精度
AI.motivation: 现有测试时放大方法对所有实例采用统一的裁剪大小和固定策略，忽略了模型在每个具体案例中的不确定性程度，导致对小图标和密集布局的GUI元素定位效果不佳
AI.method: 提出UI-Zoomer框架：1) 置信度感知门控机制，融合随机候选的空间共识和token级生成置信度，仅在定位不确定时触发放大；2) 不确定性驱动的裁剪尺寸模块，将预测方差分解为样本间位置扩展和样本内边界框范围，通过全方差定律计算每个实例的裁剪半径
AI.result: 在ScreenSpot-Pro、UI-Vision和ScreenSpot-v2数据集上的实验显示，UI-Zoomer在多种模型架构上均优于强基线方法，分别获得+13.4%、+10.3%和+4.2%的性能提升，且无需额外训练
AI.conclusion: UI-Zoomer通过将放大触发和尺度选择视为预测不确定性量化问题，实现了自适应、智能的GUI元素定位增强，显著提升了小图标和密集布局场景下的定位性能

title: DRG-Font: Dynamic Reference-Guided Few-shot Font Generation via Contrastive Style-Content Disentanglement
summary: Few-shot Font Generation aims to generate stylistically consistent glyphs from a few reference glyphs. However, capturing complex font styles from a few exemplars remains challenging, and the existing methods often struggle to retain discernible local characteristics in generated samples. This paper introduces DRG-Font, a contrastive font generation strategy that learns complex glyph attributes by decomposing style and content embedding spaces. For optimal style supervision, the proposed architecture incorporates a Reference Selection (RS) Module to dynamically select the best style reference from an available pool of candidates. The network learns to decompose glyph attributes into style and shape priors through a Multi-scale Style Head Block (MSHB) and a Multi-scale Content Head Block (MCHB). For style adaptation, a Multi-Fusion Upsampling Block (MFUB) produces the target glyph by combining the reference style prior and target content prior. The proposed method demonstrates significant improvements over state-of-the-art approaches across multiple visual and analytical benchmarks.

AI.tldr: DRG-Font是一种基于对比学习的少样本字体生成方法，通过分解样式和内容嵌入空间来学习复杂字形属性，显著提升了生成字体的风格一致性和局部特征保留能力。
AI.motivation: 少样本字体生成面临从少量参考字形中捕捉复杂字体风格的挑战，现有方法难以在生成样本中保留可辨识的局部特征。
AI.method: 提出对比字体生成策略DRG-Font：1) 参考选择模块动态选择最佳样式参考；2) 多尺度样式头块和多尺度内容头块分解字形属性为样式和形状先验；3) 多融合上采样块结合参考样式先验和目标内容先验生成目标字形。
AI.result: 该方法在多个视觉和分析基准测试中相比最先进方法取得了显著改进。
AI.conclusion: DRG-Font通过分解样式和内容嵌入空间，有效解决了少样本字体生成中复杂风格捕捉和局部特征保留的难题。

title: HiVLA: A Visual-Grounded-Centric Hierarchical Embodied Manipulation System
summary: While end-to-end Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation, fine-tuning them on narrow control data often compromises the profound reasoning capabilities inherited from their base Vision-Language Models (VLMs). To resolve this fundamental trade-off, we propose HiVLA, a visual-grounded-centric hierarchical framework that explicitly decouples high-level semantic planning from low-level motor control. In high-level part, a VLM planner first performs task decomposition and visual grounding to generate structured plans, comprising a subtask instruction and a precise target bounding box. Then, to translate this plan into physical actions, we introduce a flow-matching Diffusion Transformer (DiT) action expert in low-level part equipped with a novel cascaded cross-attention mechanism. This design sequentially fuses global context, high-resolution object-centric crops and skill semantics, enabling the DiT to focus purely on robust execution. Our decoupled architecture preserves the VLM's zero-shot reasoning while allowing independent improvement of both components. Extensive experiments in simulation and the real world demonstrate that HiVLA significantly outperforms state-of-the-art end-to-end baselines, particularly excelling in long-horizon skill composition and the fine-grained manipulation of small objects in cluttered scenes.

AI.tldr: HiVLA是一个视觉为中心的分层框架，将高层语义规划与低层运动控制解耦，通过VLM规划器生成结构化计划，再用流匹配扩散Transformer执行动作，在保持VLM零样本推理能力的同时实现精细操作。
AI.motivation: 现有的端到端视觉-语言-动作模型在微调时往往会损害其基础视觉语言模型的推理能力，需要在保持推理能力的同时实现精确的机器人操作控制。
AI.method: 提出分层框架HiVLA：高层使用VLM规划器进行任务分解和视觉定位，生成包含子任务指令和精确目标边界框的结构化计划；低层使用配备级联交叉注意力机制的流匹配扩散Transformer动作专家，顺序融合全局上下文、高分辨率物体中心裁剪和技能语义。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实世界的广泛实验中，HiVLA显著优于最先进的端到端基线方法，特别是在长时程技能组合和杂乱场景中小物体的精细操作方面表现优异。
AI.conclusion: HiVLA的解耦架构既保留了VLM的零样本推理能力，又允许两个组件独立改进，为解决机器人操作中推理与控制之间的权衡提供了有效方案。

title: Rhetorical Questions in LLM Representations: A Linear Probing Study
summary: Rhetorical questions are asked not to seek information but to persuade or signal stance. How large language models internally represent them remains unclear. We analyze rhetorical questions in LLM representations using linear probes on two social-media datasets with different discourse contexts, and find that rhetorical signals emerge early and are most stably captured by last-token representations. Rhetorical questions are linearly separable from information-seeking questions within datasets, and remain detectable under cross-dataset transfer, reaching AUROC around 0.7-0.8. However, we demonstrate that transferability does not simply imply a shared representation. Probes trained on different datasets produce different rankings when applied to the same target corpus, with overlap among the top-ranked instances often below 0.2. Qualitative analysis shows that these divergences correspond to distinct rhetorical phenomena: some probes capture discourse-level rhetorical stance embedded in extended argumentation, while others emphasize localized, syntax-driven interrogative acts. Together, these findings suggest that rhetorical questions in LLM representations are encoded by multiple linear directions emphasizing different cues, rather than a single shared direction.

AI.tldr: LLM对反问句的内部表征分析：通过线性探针发现反问句在LLM表示中早期出现且稳定，可线性分离，但跨数据集转移时表现出多方向编码而非单一共享方向
AI.motivation: 研究大型语言模型如何内部表征反问句，因为反问句不是为了寻求信息而是为了说服或表达立场，其内部表示机制尚不清楚
AI.method: 在两个不同话语背景的社交媒体数据集上使用线性探针分析LLM表示，考察反问句的线性可分性、跨数据集转移能力，并进行定性分析
AI.result: 反问句信号早期出现且最稳定地由最后标记表示捕获；在数据集内可线性分离，跨数据集检测AUROC约0.7-0.8；但转移性不代表共享表示，不同数据集训练的探针对同一目标语料产生不同排名，重叠度低于0.2
AI.conclusion: LLM表示中的反问句由多个强调不同线索的线性方向编码，而非单一共享方向，反映了话语层面修辞立场和局部语法驱动疑问行为的不同现象

title: From Where Words Come: Efficient Regularization of Code Tokenizers Through Source Attribution
summary: Efficiency and safety of Large Language Models (LLMs), among other factors, rely on the quality of tokenization. A good tokenizer not only improves inference speed and language understanding but also provides extra defense against jailbreak attacks and lowers the risk of hallucinations. In this work, we investigate the efficiency of code tokenization, in particular from the perspective of data source diversity. We demonstrate that code tokenizers are prone to producing unused, and thus under-trained, tokens due to the imbalance in repository and language diversity in the training data, as well as the dominance of source-specific, repetitive tokens that are often unusable in future inference. By modifying the BPE objective and introducing merge skipping, we implement different techniques under the name Source-Attributed BPE (SA-BPE) to regularize BPE training and minimize overfitting, thereby substantially reducing the number of under-trained tokens while maintaining the same inference procedure as with regular BPE. This provides an effective tool suitable for production use.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为SA-BPE（源属性BPE）的改进方法，通过修改BPE目标函数和引入合并跳过机制，解决代码分词器中因训练数据源多样性不足导致的未使用/未充分训练token问题，从而提升LLM的效率和安全性。
AI.motivation: 代码分词器的质量对LLM的效率和安全性至关重要。当前代码分词器存在未使用/未充分训练token的问题，这主要源于训练数据中仓库和语言多样性的不平衡，以及特定源代码中重复token的过度主导，这些token在后续推理中往往无法使用。
AI.method: 提出Source-Attributed BPE (SA-BPE)方法，通过修改BPE目标函数和引入合并跳过机制来正则化BPE训练，减少过拟合。该方法保持与常规BPE相同的推理过程，适合生产环境使用。
AI.result: SA-BPE方法显著减少了未充分训练token的数量，同时保持了与常规BPE相同的推理过程，为生产环境提供了有效的工具。
AI.conclusion: 通过SA-BPE方法可以有效地解决代码分词器中因数据源多样性不足导致的未使用token问题，提升LLM的效率和安全性，同时保持向后兼容性，适合生产部署。

title: A Resource-Efficient Hybrid CNN-LSTM network for image-based bean leaf disease classification
summary: Accurate and resource-efficient automated diagnosis is a cornerstone of modern agricultural expert systems. While Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have established benchmarks in plant pathology, their ability to capture long-range spatial dependencies is often limited by standard pooling layers, and their high memory footprint hinders deployment on portable devices. This paper proposes a lightweight hybrid CNN-LSTM system for bean leaf disease classification. By integrating an LSTM layer to model the spatial-sequential relationships within feature maps, our hybrid architecture achieves a 94.38% accuracy while maintaining an exceptionally small footprint of 1.86 MB; a 70% reduction in size compared to traditional CNN-based systems. Furthermore, we provide a systematic evaluation of image augmentation strategies, demonstrating that tailored transformations are superior to generic combinations for maintaining the integrity of diagnostic patterns. Results on the $\textit{ibean}$ dataset confirm that the proposed system achieves state-of-the-art F1 scores of 99.22% with EfficientNet-B7+LSTM, providing a robust and scalable framework for real-time agricultural decision support in resource-constrained environments. The code and augmented datasets used in this study are publicly available on this $\href{https://github.com/HJin-R/bean_disease}{Github}$ repo.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种轻量级CNN-LSTM混合系统用于豆叶病害分类，在保持94.38%准确率的同时将模型大小减少70%至1.86MB，并通过定制化图像增强策略实现了99.22%的F1分数。
AI.motivation: 传统CNN在植物病理学诊断中存在两个主要问题：1）标准池化层难以捕捉长距离空间依赖关系；2）高内存占用阻碍在便携设备上的部署。需要开发既准确又资源高效的农业专家系统。
AI.method: 提出轻量级CNN-LSTM混合架构，通过集成LSTM层来建模特征图内的空间序列关系。同时系统评估图像增强策略，证明定制化变换比通用组合更能保持诊断模式的完整性。
AI.result: 在ibean数据集上，混合架构达到94.38%的准确率，模型大小仅1.86MB（相比传统CNN系统减少70%）。EfficientNet-B7+LSTM组合实现了99.22%的F1分数，达到最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为资源受限环境下的实时农业决策支持提供了鲁棒且可扩展的框架，证明了轻量级混合架构在农业病害诊断中的有效性，相关代码和增强数据集已开源。

title: From Feelings to Metrics: Understanding and Formalizing How Users Vibe-Test LLMs
comment: TLDR: Under review. 42 pages, 18 figures. Code and data at https://itay1itzhak.github.io/vibe-testing-llms Subjects: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
summary: Evaluating LLMs is challenging, as benchmark scores often fail to capture models' real-world usefulness. Instead, users often rely on ``vibe-testing'': informal experience-based evaluation, such as comparing models on coding tasks related to their own workflow. While prevalent, vibe-testing is often too ad hoc and unstructured to analyze or reproduce at scale. In this work, we study how vibe-testing works in practice and then formalize it to support systematic analysis. We first analyze two empirical resources: (1) a survey of user evaluation practices, and (2) a collection of in-the-wild model comparison reports from blogs and social media. Based on these resources, we formalize vibe-testing as a two-part process: users personalize both what they test and how they judge responses. We then introduce a proof-of-concept evaluation pipeline that follows this formulation by generating personalized prompts and comparing model outputs using user-aware subjective criteria. In experiments on coding benchmarks, we find that combining personalized prompts and user-aware evaluation can change which model is preferred, reflecting the role of vibe-testing in practice. These findings suggest that formalized vibe-testing can serve as a useful approach for bridging benchmark scores and real-world experience.

AI.tldr: 论文提出将用户常用的"氛围测试"（非正式经验性评估）形式化，通过个性化提示和用户感知的主观标准来评估LLM，以弥补基准测试与实际使用体验之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM评估存在挑战，基准测试分数往往无法反映模型在实际使用中的有效性。用户通常依赖"氛围测试"（非正式的经验性评估），但这种方法过于临时性和非结构化，难以进行规模化分析和复现。
AI.method: 1. 分析用户评估实践：通过调查用户评估实践和收集博客、社交媒体上的模型比较报告；2. 将氛围测试形式化为两个部分：用户个性化测试内容和判断标准；3. 引入概念验证评估流程，生成个性化提示并使用用户感知的主观标准比较模型输出。
AI.result: 在编码基准测试实验中，结合个性化提示和用户感知评估可以改变模型偏好，反映了氛围测试在实际中的作用。这表明形式化的氛围测试可以作为连接基准分数和实际使用体验的有用方法。
AI.conclusion: 形式化的氛围测试能够系统化地捕捉用户实际使用中的评估标准，为LLM评估提供更贴近实际应用的框架，弥补传统基准测试与实际使用体验之间的差距。

title: From Weights to Activations: Is Steering the Next Frontier of Adaptation?
summary:
Post-training adaptation of language models is commonly achieved through parameter updates or input-based methods such as fine-tuning, parameter-efficient adaptation, and prompting. In parallel, a growing body of work modifies internal activations at inference time to influence model behavior, an approach known as steering. Despite increasing use, steering is rarely analyzed within the same conceptual framework as established adaptation methods.
  In this work, we argue that steering should be regarded as a form of model adaptation. We introduce a set of functional criteria for adaptation methods and use them to compare steering approaches with classical alternatives. This analysis positions steering as a distinct adaptation paradigm based on targeted interventions in activation space, enabling local and reversible behavioral change without parameter updates. The resulting framing clarifies how steering relates to existing methods, motivating a unified taxonomy for model adaptation.

AI.tldr: 该论文将"引导"（steering）定位为一种新的模型适应范式，通过干预激活空间来影响模型行为，无需参数更新
AI.motivation: 当前语言模型适应方法主要分为参数更新（如微调）和输入方法（如提示），而引导方法通过修改推理时的内部激活来影响模型行为，但缺乏与现有适应方法的统一分析框架
AI.method: 提出一套功能标准来比较引导方法与经典适应方法，将引导定位为基于激活空间针对性干预的独特适应范式
AI.result: 引导被确立为一种独立的适应范式，能够实现局部、可逆的行为改变而无需参数更新，为模型适应提供了统一的分类体系
AI.conclusion: 引导应被视为模型适应的一种形式，其基于激活空间干预的特性为模型行为控制提供了新的可能性，促进了模型适应方法的统一分类

title: DiffMagicFace: Identity Consistent Facial Editing of Real Videos
summary: Text-conditioned image editing has greatly benefitted from the advancements in Image Diffusion Models. However, extending these techniques to facial video editing introduces challenges in preserving facial identity throughout the source video and ensuring consistency of the edited subject across frames. In this paper, we introduce DiffMagicFace, a unique video editing framework that integrates two fine-tuned models for text and image control. These models operate concurrently during inference to produce video frames that maintain identity features while seamlessly aligning with the editing semantics. To ensure the consistency of the edited videos, we develop a dataset comprising images showcasing various facial perspectives for each edited subject. The creation of a data set is achieved through rendering techniques and the subsequent application of optimization algorithms. Remarkably, our approach does not depend on video datasets but still delivers high-quality results in both consistency and content. The excellent effect holds even for complex tasks like talking head videos and distinguishing closely related categories. The videos edited using our framework exhibit parity with videos that are made using traditional rendering software. Through comparative analysis with current state-of-the-art methods, our framework demonstrates superior performance in both visual appeal and quantitative metrics.

AI.tldr: DiffMagicFace是一个基于扩散模型的视频编辑框架，通过集成两个微调模型实现文本和图像控制，能够在保持面部身份一致性的同时进行语义编辑，无需依赖视频数据集。
AI.motivation: 基于文本条件的图像编辑技术已取得显著进展，但将其扩展到面部视频编辑面临两个主要挑战：保持源视频中面部身份的一致性，以及确保编辑对象在不同帧间的连贯性。
AI.method: 提出DiffMagicFace框架，集成两个微调模型分别进行文本和图像控制，在推理时并行工作生成视频帧。通过渲染技术和优化算法创建包含不同面部视角的数据集来确保一致性，无需依赖视频数据集。
AI.result: 框架在视觉质量和定量指标上均优于现有方法，即使对于复杂的说话头部视频和区分相近类别等任务也能保持高质量结果，编辑效果与传统渲染软件制作的视频相当。
AI.conclusion: DiffMagicFace通过创新的双模型集成方法，成功解决了面部视频编辑中的身份保持和一致性难题，为基于扩散模型的视频编辑提供了有效解决方案。

title: Interpretable Stylistic Variation in Human and LLM Writing Across Genres, Models, and Decoding Strategies
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are now capable of generating highly fluent, human-like text. They enable many applications, but also raise concerns such as large scale spam, phishing, or academic misuse. While much work has focused on detecting LLM-generated text, only limited work has gone into understanding the stylistic differences between human-written and machine-generated text. In this work, we perform a large scale analysis of stylistic variation across human-written text and outputs from 11 LLMs spanning 8 different genres and 4 decoding strategies using Douglas Biber's set of lexicogrammatical and functional features. Our findings reveal insights that can guide intentional LLM usage. First, key linguistic differentiators of LLM-generated text seem robust to generation conditions (e.g., prompt settings to nudge them to generate human-like text, or availability of human-written text to continue the style); second, genre exerts a stronger influence on stylistic features than the source itself; third, chat variants of the models generally appear to be clustered together in stylistic space, and finally, model has a larger effect on the style than decoding strategy, with some exceptions. These results highlight the relative importance of model and genre over prompting and decoding strategies in shaping the stylistic behavior of machine-generated text.

AI.tldr: 该研究对11个大型语言模型在8种文体和4种解码策略下生成的文本进行大规模风格分析，发现模型和文体对文本风格的影响比提示和解码策略更重要。
AI.motivation: 虽然LLM能够生成高度流畅、类人的文本，引发了大规模垃圾邮件、网络钓鱼或学术滥用等担忧，但现有研究主要关注检测LLM生成文本，对人工写作与机器生成文本之间的风格差异理解有限。
AI.method: 使用Douglas Biber的词汇语法和功能特征集，对人工写作文本和11个LLM在8种不同文体和4种解码策略下生成的输出进行大规模风格变异分析。
AI.result: 研究发现：1）LLM生成文本的关键语言区分特征对生成条件具有鲁棒性；2）文体对风格特征的影响比来源本身更强；3）模型的聊天变体在风格空间中通常聚集在一起；4）模型对风格的影响大于解码策略（少数例外）。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，在塑造机器生成文本的风格行为方面，模型和文体的相对重要性超过了提示和解码策略，这些发现可以指导有意图的LLM使用。

title: Any3DAvatar: Fast and High-Quality Full-Head 3D Avatar Reconstruction from Single Portrait Image
summary: Reconstructing a complete 3D head from a single portrait remains challenging because existing methods still face a sharp quality-speed trade-off: high-fidelity pipelines often rely on multi-stage processing and per-subject optimization, while fast feed-forward models struggle with complete geometry and fine appearance details. To bridge this gap, we propose Any3DAvatar, a fast and high-quality method for single-image 3D Gaussian head avatar generation, whose fastest setting reconstructs a full head in under one second while preserving high-fidelity geometry and texture. First, we build AnyHead, a unified data suite that combines identity diversity, dense multi-view supervision, and realistic accessories, filling the main gaps of existing head data in coverage, full-head geometry, and complex appearance. Second, rather than sampling unstructured noise, we initialize from a Plücker-aware structured 3D Gaussian scaffold and perform one-step conditional denoising, formulating full-head reconstruction into a single forward pass while retaining high fidelity. Third, we introduce auxiliary view-conditioned appearance supervision on the same latent tokens alongside 3D Gaussian reconstruction, improving novel-view texture details at zero extra inference cost. Experiments show that Any3DAvatar outperforms prior single-image full-head reconstruction methods in rendering fidelity while remaining substantially faster.

AI.tldr: Any3DAvatar：一种快速高质量的单图像3D高斯头像生成方法，最快可在1秒内重建完整头部，同时保持高保真几何和纹理
AI.motivation: 现有单图像3D头部重建方法面临质量与速度的权衡：高保真方法依赖多阶段处理和逐主体优化，而快速前馈模型在完整几何和精细外观细节方面表现不佳
AI.method: 1) 构建AnyHead统一数据集，包含身份多样性、密集多视角监督和真实配饰；2) 从Plücker感知的结构化3D高斯支架初始化，执行一步条件去噪；3) 在相同潜在标记上引入辅助视角条件外观监督
AI.result: 实验表明，Any3DAvatar在渲染保真度方面优于先前的单图像完整头部重建方法，同时保持显著更快的速度
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过统一数据集、结构化初始化和辅助监督，实现了快速高质量的单图像3D头部重建，在质量和速度之间取得了良好平衡

title: Correct Prediction, Wrong Steps? Consensus Reasoning Knowledge Graph for Robust Chain-of-Thought Synthesis
summary: LLM reasoning traces suffer from complex flaws -- *Step Internal Flaws* (logical errors, hallucinations, etc.) and *Step-wise Flaws* (overthinking, underthinking), which vary by sample. A natural approach would be to provide ground-truth labels to guide LLMs' reasoning. Contrary to intuition, we show that this yields no improvement in reasoning ability. We then propose CRAFT, a unified framework that mitigates both types of Step flaws, which builds a Reasoning Knowledge Graph (RKG) based on the consensus parts of multiple candidate traces, and synthesizes a high-quality trace through topological generation. Our approach improves label-prediction accuracy by 10+% on average, and consistently outperforms all baselines across both logical and mathematical reasoning benchmarks. Further, detailed benchmark evaluation proves that our method also improves the quality of LLMs' reasoning traces in multiple dimensions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出CRAFT框架，通过构建推理知识图谱和拓扑生成来解决LLM推理中的步骤内部缺陷和步骤间缺陷，显著提升推理准确性和质量。
AI.motivation: LLM推理轨迹存在复杂的缺陷：步骤内部缺陷（逻辑错误、幻觉等）和步骤间缺陷（过度思考、思考不足），这些缺陷因样本而异。传统方法提供真实标签指导LLM推理，但实验表明这并不能改善推理能力。
AI.method: 提出CRAFT统一框架：1）基于多个候选推理轨迹的共识部分构建推理知识图谱（RKG）；2）通过拓扑生成合成高质量推理轨迹。该方法能同时缓解两种类型的步骤缺陷。
AI.result: 在逻辑和数学推理基准测试中，CRAFT将标签预测准确率平均提升10%以上，始终优于所有基线方法。详细的基准评估证明该方法在多个维度上改善了LLM推理轨迹的质量。
AI.conclusion: CRAFT框架通过构建推理知识图谱和拓扑生成，有效解决了LLM推理中的复杂缺陷问题，显著提升了推理准确性和推理轨迹质量，为LLM推理改进提供了新思路。

title: PostureObjectstitch: Anomaly Image Generation Considering Assembly Relationships in Industrial Scenarios
summary: Image generation technology can synthesize condition-specific images to supplement real-world industrial anomaly data and enhance anomaly detection model performance. Existing generation techniques rarely account for the pose and orientation of industrial components in assembly, making the generated images difficult to utilize for downstream application. To solve this, we propose a novel image synthesis approach, called PostureObjectStitch, that achieves accurate generation to meet the requirement of industrial assembly. A condition decoupling approach is introduced to separate input multi-view images into high-frequency, texture, and RGB features. The feature temporal modulation mechanism adapts these features across diffusion model time-steps, enabling progressive generation from coarse to fine details while maintaining consistency. To ensure semantic accuracy, we introduce a conditional loss that enhances critical industrial elements and a geometric prior that guides component positioning for correct assembly relationships. Comprehensive experimental results on the MureCom dataset, our newly contributed DreamAssembly dataset, and the downstream application validate the outstanding performance of our method.

AI.tldr: 提出PostureObjectStitch方法，通过条件解耦和特征时间调制机制，生成符合工业装配姿态要求的图像，补充异常检测数据
AI.motivation: 现有图像生成技术很少考虑工业组件在装配中的姿态和方向，导致生成的图像难以用于下游应用，需要解决这一问题来增强工业异常检测性能
AI.method: 提出PostureObjectStitch方法：1) 条件解耦将多视角图像分离为高频、纹理和RGB特征；2) 特征时间调制机制在扩散模型时间步中自适应特征；3) 引入条件损失增强关键工业元素；4) 几何先验指导组件定位确保正确装配关系
AI.result: 在MureCom数据集、新贡献的DreamAssembly数据集和下游应用上的综合实验验证了方法的优异性能
AI.conclusion: PostureObjectStitch方法能够准确生成符合工业装配要求的图像，有效补充异常检测数据，提升下游应用性能

title: Context Sensitivity Improves Human-Machine Visual Alignment
summary: Modern machine learning models typically represent inputs as fixed points in a high-dimensional embedding space. While this approach has been proven powerful for a wide range of downstream tasks, it fundamentally differs from the way humans process information. Because humans are constantly adapting to their environment, they represent objects and their relationships in a highly context-sensitive manner. To address this gap, we propose a method for context-sensitive similarity computation from neural network embeddings, applied to modeling a triplet odd-one-out task with an anchor image serving as simultaneous context. Modeling context enables us to achieve up to a 15% improvement in odd-one-out accuracy over a context-insensitive model. We find that this improvement is consistent across both original and "human-aligned" vision foundation models.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种从神经网络嵌入中计算上下文敏感相似度的方法，用于建模三元组"找出不同"任务，相比上下文不敏感模型提高了15%的准确率
AI.motivation: 现代机器学习模型通常将输入表示为高维嵌入空间中的固定点，这与人类处理信息的方式不同。人类会根据环境不断适应，以高度上下文敏感的方式表示对象及其关系
AI.method: 提出了一种从神经网络嵌入中计算上下文敏感相似度的方法，应用于建模三元组"找出不同"任务，其中锚点图像同时作为上下文
AI.result: 建模上下文使得在"找出不同"任务准确率上相比上下文不敏感模型提高了15%。这种改进在原始视觉基础模型和"人类对齐"视觉基础模型中都保持一致
AI.conclusion: 通过引入上下文敏感相似度计算，可以更好地模拟人类的信息处理方式，在视觉任务中取得显著性能提升

title: Rethinking Image-to-3D Generation with Sparse Queries: Efficiency, Capacity, and Input-View Bias
summary: We present SparseGen, a novel framework for efficient image-to-3D generation, which exhibits low input-view bias while being significantly faster. Unlike traditional approaches that rely on dense volumetric grids, triplanes, or pixel-aligned primitives, we model scenes with a compact sparse set of learned 3D anchor queries and a learned expansion operator that decodes each transformed query into a small local set of 3D Gaussian primitives. Trained under a rectified-flow reconstruction objective without 3D supervision, our model learns to allocate representation capacity where geometry and appearance matter, achieving significant reductions in memory and inference time while preserving multi-view fidelity. We introduce quantitative measures of input-view bias and utilization to show that sparse queries reduce overfitting to conditioning views while being representationally efficient. Our results argue that sparse set-latent expansion is a principled, practical alternative for efficient 3D generative modeling.

AI.tldr: SparseGen是一个新颖的高效图像到3D生成框架，通过稀疏3D锚点查询和扩展操作器实现快速生成，减少输入视图偏差，显著降低内存和推理时间。
AI.motivation: 传统方法依赖密集体积网格、三平面或像素对齐基元，导致内存消耗大、推理时间长，且容易过度拟合输入视图。需要一种更高效、减少输入视图偏差的3D生成方法。
AI.method: 使用紧凑的稀疏学习3D锚点查询集和学习的扩展操作器，将每个变换后的查询解码为一小组局部3D高斯基元。在无3D监督的整流流重建目标下训练，模型学习在几何和外观重要的地方分配表示能力。
AI.result: 显著减少了内存和推理时间，同时保持了多视图保真度。引入的输入视图偏差和利用率定量测量显示，稀疏查询减少了条件视图的过拟合，同时保持了表示效率。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏集合潜在扩展是高效3D生成建模的一个原则性、实用的替代方案，在保持质量的同时显著提升了效率。

title: Blind Bitstream-corrupted Video Recovery via Metadata-guided Diffusion Model
summary: Bitstream-corrupted video recovery aims to restore realistic content degraded during video storage or transmission. Existing methods typically assume that predefined masks of corrupted regions are available, but manually annotating these masks is labor-intensive and impractical in real-world scenarios. To address this limitation, we introduce a new blind video recovery setting that removes the reliance on predefined masks. This setting presents two major challenges: accurately identifying corrupted regions and recovering content from extensive and irregular degradations. We propose a Metadata-Guided Diffusion Model (M-GDM) to tackle these challenges. Specifically, intrinsic video metadata are leveraged as corruption indicators through a dual-stream metadata encoder that separately embeds motion vectors and frame types before fusing them into a unified representation. This representation interacts with corrupted latent features via cross-attention at each diffusion step. To preserve intact regions, we design a prior-driven mask predictor that generates pseudo masks using both metadata and diffusion priors, enabling the separation and recombination of intact and recovered regions through hard masking. To mitigate boundary artifacts caused by imperfect masks, a post-refinement module enhances consistency between intact and recovered regions. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method and its superiority in blind video recovery. Code is available at: https://github.com/Shuyun-Wang/M-GDM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需预定义掩码的盲视频恢复方法M-GDM，利用视频元数据作为损坏指示器，通过双流元数据编码器、先验驱动的掩码预测器和后处理细化模块，有效解决了比特流损坏视频的恢复问题。
AI.motivation: 现有视频恢复方法通常需要预定义的损坏区域掩码，但手动标注这些掩码既耗时又不切实际。为了解决这一限制，本文引入了无需依赖预定义掩码的盲视频恢复设置，这带来了两个主要挑战：准确识别损坏区域以及从广泛且不规则的退化中恢复内容。
AI.method: 提出了元数据引导的扩散模型（M-GDM）。具体包括：1）利用视频固有元数据作为损坏指示器，通过双流元数据编码器分别嵌入运动向量和帧类型，然后融合成统一表示；2）设计先验驱动的掩码预测器，利用元数据和扩散先验生成伪掩码，通过硬掩码分离和重组完整区域与恢复区域；3）引入后处理细化模块以减少不完美掩码引起的边界伪影。
AI.result: 大量实验证明了该方法的有效性，在盲视频恢复任务中表现出优越性能。代码已在GitHub上开源。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的M-GDM方法成功解决了无需预定义掩码的盲视频恢复问题，通过有效利用视频元数据和扩散模型，实现了对损坏区域的准确识别和高质量内容恢复，为实际应用提供了实用解决方案。

title: ASTRA: Enhancing Multi-Subject Generation with Retrieval-Augmented Pose Guidance and Disentangled Position Embedding
summary: Subject-driven image generation has shown great success in creating personalized content, but its capabilities are largely confined to single subjects in common poses. Current approaches face a fundamental conflict when handling multiple subjects with complex, distinct actions: preserving individual identities while enforcing precise pose structures. This challenge often leads to identity fusion and pose distortion, as appearance and structure signals become entangled within the model's architecture. To resolve this conflict, we introduce ASTRA(Adaptive Synthesis through Targeted Retrieval Augmentation), a novel framework that architecturally disentangles subject appearance from pose structure within a unified Diffusion Transformer. ASTRA achieves this through a dual-pronged strategy. It first employs a Retrieval-Augmented Pose (RAG-Pose) pipeline to provide a clean, explicit structural prior from a curated database. Then, its core generative model learns to process these dual visual conditions using our Enhanced Universal Rotary Position Embedding (EURoPE), an asymmetric encoding mechanism that decouples identity tokens from spatial locations while binding pose tokens to the canvas. Concurrently, a Disentangled Semantic Modulation (DSM) adapter offloads the identity preservation task into the text conditioning stream. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our integrated approach achieves superior disentanglement. On our designed COCO-based complex pose benchmark, ASTRA achieves a new state-of-the-art in pose adherence, while maintaining high identity fidelity and text alignment in DreamBench.

AI.tldr: ASTRA框架通过检索增强的姿势先验和不对称编码机制，解决了多主体复杂姿势生成中的身份融合和姿势失真问题，实现了身份与姿势的结构性解耦。
AI.motivation: 当前基于主题的图像生成方法在处理多主体复杂动作时面临根本性冲突：既要保持个体身份又要精确执行姿势结构，这常常导致身份融合和姿势失真，因为外观和结构信号在模型架构中纠缠在一起。
AI.method: ASTRA采用双管齐下策略：1）检索增强姿势（RAG-Pose）管道从精选数据库提供清晰的结构先验；2）核心生成模型使用增强通用旋转位置嵌入（EURoPE）处理双重视觉条件，该机制将身份标记与空间位置解耦，同时将姿势标记绑定到画布；3）解耦语义调制（DSM）适配器将身份保持任务卸载到文本条件流中。
AI.result: 在设计的基于COCO的复杂姿势基准测试中，ASTRA在姿势遵循方面达到了新的最先进水平，同时在DreamBench中保持了高身份保真度和文本对齐。
AI.conclusion: ASTRA通过架构上解耦主体外观和姿势结构，在统一扩散变换器中解决了多主体复杂姿势生成中的根本冲突，实现了卓越的解耦性能。

title: SceneGlue: Scene-Aware Transformer for Feature Matching without Scene-Level Annotation
summary: Local feature matching plays a critical role in understanding the correspondence between cross-view images. However, traditional methods are constrained by the inherent local nature of feature descriptors, limiting their ability to capture non-local scene information that is essential for accurate cross-view correspondence. In this paper, we introduce SceneGlue, a scene-aware feature matching framework designed to overcome these limitations. SceneGlue leverages a hybridizable matching paradigm that integrates implicit parallel attention and explicit cross-view visibility estimation. The parallel attention mechanism simultaneously exchanges information among local descriptors within and across images, enhancing the scene's global context. To further enrich the scene awareness, we propose the Visibility Transformer, which explicitly categorizes features into visible and invisible regions, providing an understanding of cross-view scene visibility. By combining explicit and implicit scene-level awareness, SceneGlue effectively compensates for the local descriptor constraints. Notably, SceneGlue is trained using only local feature matches, without requiring scene-level groundtruth annotations. This scene-aware approach not only improves accuracy and robustness but also enhances interpretability compared to traditional methods. Extensive experiments on applications such as homography estimation, pose estimation, image matching, and visual localization validate SceneGlue's superior performance. The source code is available at https://github.com/songlin-du/SceneGlue.

AI.tldr: SceneGlue是一个场景感知的特征匹配框架，通过混合化匹配范式结合隐式并行注意力和显式跨视图可见性估计，克服传统局部特征描述符的限制，提升跨视图图像对应关系的准确性。
AI.motivation: 传统局部特征匹配方法受限于特征描述符的局部性质，难以捕捉对跨视图对应关系至关重要的非局部场景信息，需要一种能够理解场景全局上下文的方法。
AI.method: 提出SceneGlue框架，采用混合化匹配范式：1) 隐式并行注意力机制，在图像内部和跨图像间同时交换局部描述符信息；2) 显式可见性变换器，将特征分类为可见和不可见区域，理解跨视图场景可见性。
AI.result: SceneGlue在单应性估计、姿态估计、图像匹配和视觉定位等应用中表现出优越性能，仅使用局部特征匹配进行训练，无需场景级标注数据。
AI.conclusion: SceneGlue通过结合显式和隐式场景级感知，有效补偿了局部描述符的限制，不仅提高了匹配的准确性和鲁棒性，还增强了可解释性，为跨视图图像对应关系提供了更好的解决方案。

title: Heuristic Style Transfer for Real-Time, Efficient Weather Attribute Detection
summary: We present lightweight and efficient architectures to detect weather conditions from RGB images, predicting the weather type (sunny, rain, snow, fog) and 11 complementary attributes such as intensity, visibility, and ground condition, for a total of 53 classes across the tasks. This work examines to what extent weather conditions manifest as variations in visual style. We investigate style-inspired techniques, including Gram matrices, a truncated ResNet-50 targeting lower and intermediate layers, and PatchGAN-style architectures, within a multi-task framework with attention mechanisms. Two families are introduced: RTM (ResNet50-Truncated-MultiTasks) and PMG (PatchGAN-MultiTasks-Gram), together with their variants. Our contributions include automation of Gram-matrix computation, integration of PatchGAN into supervised multi-task learning, and local style capture through local Gram for improved spatial coherence. We also release a dataset of 503,875 images annotated with 12 weather attributes under a Creative Commons Attribution (CC-BY) license. The models achieve F1 scores above 96 percent on our internal test set and above 78 percent in zero-shot evaluation on several external datasets, confirming their generalization ability. The PMG architecture, with fewer than 5 million parameters, runs in real time with a small memory footprint, making it suitable for embedded systems. The modular design of the models also allows style-related or weather-related tasks to be added or removed as needed.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量高效的天气检测架构，通过视觉风格变化识别天气类型和11个补充属性，使用Gram矩阵、截断ResNet-50和PatchGAN风格架构，在嵌入式系统中实现实时运行
AI.motivation: 研究天气条件在多大程度上表现为视觉风格的变化，开发能够实时运行在嵌入式系统上的轻量级天气检测模型
AI.method: 提出两种架构家族：RTM（基于截断ResNet-50的多任务学习）和PMG（结合PatchGAN和Gram矩阵的多任务学习），采用注意力机制和局部Gram矩阵捕捉空间一致性
AI.result: 在内部测试集上F1分数超过96%，在多个外部数据集上的零样本评估超过78%，PMG架构参数少于500万，具有实时运行和小内存占用的特点
AI.conclusion: 天气条件确实表现为视觉风格变化，提出的轻量级架构在保持高精度的同时适合嵌入式应用，模型模块化设计便于任务扩展，并发布了包含50多万张图像的数据集

title: Remote Sensing Image Super-Resolution for Imbalanced Textures: A Texture-Aware Diffusion Framework
summary: Generative diffusion priors have recently achieved state-of-the-art performance in natural image super-resolution, demonstrating a powerful capability to synthesize photorealistic details. However, their direct application to remote sensing image super-resolution (RSISR) reveals significant shortcomings. Unlike natural images, remote sensing images exhibit a unique texture distribution where ground objects are globally stochastic yet locally clustered, leading to highly imbalanced textures. This imbalance severely hinders the model's spatial perception. To address this, we propose TexADiff, a novel framework that begins by estimating a Relative Texture Density Map (RTDM) to represent the texture distribution. TexADiff then leverages this RTDM in three synergistic ways: as an explicit spatial conditioning to guide the diffusion process, as a loss modulation term to prioritize texture-rich regions, and as a dynamic adapter for the sampling schedule. These modifications are designed to endow the model with explicit texture-aware capabilities. Experiments demonstrate that TexADiff achieves superior or competitive quantitative metrics. Furthermore, qualitative results show that our model generates faithful high-frequency details while effectively suppressing texture hallucinations. This improved reconstruction quality also results in significant gains in downstream task performance. The source code of our method can be found at https://github.com/ZezFuture/TexAdiff.

AI.tldr: TexADiff是一个针对遥感图像超分辨率的新框架，通过相对纹理密度图来引导扩散过程，解决遥感图像纹理分布不平衡的问题，提升超分辨率质量。
AI.motivation: 传统生成扩散先验在自然图像超分辨率中表现出色，但直接应用于遥感图像超分辨率时存在显著不足。遥感图像具有独特的纹理分布特征：地面物体全局随机但局部聚集，导致高度不平衡的纹理分布，这严重阻碍了模型的空间感知能力。
AI.method: 提出TexADiff框架：首先估计相对纹理密度图来表示纹理分布；然后以三种协同方式利用RTDM：1)作为显式空间条件引导扩散过程；2)作为损失调制项优先处理纹理丰富区域；3)作为采样计划的动态适配器，赋予模型显式的纹理感知能力。
AI.result: 实验表明TexADiff在定量指标上达到优越或竞争性水平。定性结果显示模型能够生成忠实的高频细节，同时有效抑制纹理幻觉。改进的重建质量还带来了下游任务性能的显著提升。
AI.conclusion: TexADiff通过引入相对纹理密度图来引导扩散过程，成功解决了遥感图像超分辨率中的纹理分布不平衡问题，提高了重建质量和下游任务性能，为遥感图像处理提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Depth-Aware Image and Video Orientation Estimation
summary: This paper introduces a novel approach for image and video orientation estimation by leveraging depth distribution in natural images. The proposed method estimates the orientation based on the depth distribution across different quadrants of the image, providing a robust framework for orientation estimation suited for applications such as virtual reality (VR), augmented reality (AR), autonomous navigation, and interactive surveillance systems. To further enhance fine-scale perceptual alignment, we incorporate depth gradient consistency (DGC) and horizontal symmetry analysis (HSA), enabling precise orientation correction. This hybrid strategy effectively exploits depth cues to support spatial coherence and perceptual stability in immersive visual content. Qualitative and quantitative evaluations demonstrate the robustness and accuracy of the proposed approach, outperforming existing techniques across diverse scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出基于深度分布估计图像和视频方向的新方法，通过分析图像不同象限的深度分布，结合深度梯度一致性和水平对称性分析，实现精确的方向估计和校正。
AI.motivation: 在虚拟现实、增强现实、自主导航和交互式监控等应用中，准确估计图像和视频的方向对于空间一致性和感知稳定性至关重要。传统方法可能无法充分利用深度信息进行精确的方向估计。
AI.method: 通过分析自然图像中不同象限的深度分布来估计方向，结合深度梯度一致性（DGC）和水平对称性分析（HSA）进行精细尺度感知对齐，形成混合策略以利用深度线索支持空间一致性和感知稳定性。
AI.result: 定性和定量评估表明该方法具有鲁棒性和准确性，在多种场景下优于现有技术。
AI.conclusion: 基于深度分布的方向估计方法为图像和视频方向校正提供了有效的解决方案，特别适用于需要空间一致性和感知稳定性的沉浸式视觉内容应用。

title: POINTS-Seeker: Towards Training a Multimodal Agentic Search Model from Scratch
summary: While Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) demonstrate impressive visual perception, they remain epistemically constrained by their static parametric knowledge. To transcend these boundaries, multimodal search models have been adopted to actively interact with the external environment for evidence retrieval. Diverging from prevailing paradigms that merely retrofit general LMMs with search tools as modular extensions, we explore the potential of building a multimodal agentic search model from scratch. Specifically, we make the following contributions: (i) we introduce Agentic Seeding, a dedicated phase designed to weave the foundational precursors necessary for eliciting agentic behaviors; (ii) we uncover a performance bottleneck in long-horizon interactions, where the increasing volume of interaction history overwhelms the model's ability to locate ground-truth evidence. To mitigate this, we propose V-Fold, an adaptive history-aware compression scheme that preserves recent dialogue turns in high fidelity while folding historical context into the visual space via rendering; and (iii) we develop POINTS-Seeker-8B, a state-of-the-art multimodal agentic search model that consistently outperforms existing models across six diverse benchmarks, effectively resolving the challenges of long-horizon, knowledge-intensive visual reasoning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种从头构建多模态代理搜索模型的方法，通过Agentic Seeding阶段激发代理行为，使用V-Fold压缩方案解决长时程交互中的历史信息过载问题，最终开发出性能优越的POINTS-Seeker-8B模型。
AI.motivation: 大型多模态模型虽然具有强大的视觉感知能力，但受限于静态参数知识。现有方法通常只是为通用LMM添加搜索工具作为模块扩展，而本文探索从头构建多模态代理搜索模型的潜力，以超越这些限制。
AI.method: 1. 引入Agentic Seeding阶段，为激发代理行为编织必要的基础前驱；2. 提出V-Fold自适应历史感知压缩方案，高保真保留近期对话轮次，同时通过渲染将历史上下文折叠到视觉空间；3. 开发POINTS-Seeker-8B多模态代理搜索模型。
AI.result: POINTS-Seeker-8B在六个不同的基准测试中始终优于现有模型，有效解决了长时程、知识密集型视觉推理的挑战。
AI.conclusion: 通过从头构建多模态代理搜索模型，结合Agentic Seeding和V-Fold压缩方案，可以显著提升模型在长时程交互中的性能，超越现有基于模块扩展的方法。

title: Seek-and-Solve: Benchmarking MLLMs for Visual Clue-Driven Reasoning in Daily Scenarios
summary: Daily scenarios are characterized by visual richness, requiring Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to filter noise and identify decisive visual clues for accurate reasoning. Yet, current benchmarks predominantly aim at evaluating MLLMs' pre-existing knowledge or perceptual understanding, often neglecting the critical capability of reasoning. To bridge this gap, we introduce DailyClue, a benchmark designed for visual clue-driven reasoning in daily scenarios. Our construction is guided by two core principles: (1) strict grounding in authentic daily activities, and (2) challenging query design that necessitates more than surface-level perception. Instead of simple recognition, our questions compel MLLMs to actively explore suitable visual clues and leverage them for subsequent reasoning. To this end, we curate a comprehensive dataset spanning four major daily domains and 16 distinct subtasks. Comprehensive evaluation across MLLMs and agentic models underscores the formidable challenge posed by our benchmark. Our analysis reveals several critical insights, emphasizing that the accurate identification of visual clues is essential for robust reasoning.

AI.tldr: DailyClue是一个专注于日常场景中视觉线索驱动推理的基准测试，旨在评估多模态大语言模型在复杂日常环境中识别关键视觉线索并进行推理的能力，而非简单的感知识别。
AI.motivation: 当前基准测试主要评估MLLMs的已有知识或感知理解能力，往往忽视了关键的推理能力。日常场景具有视觉丰富性，需要MLLMs能够过滤噪声并识别决定性的视觉线索来进行准确推理。
AI.method: 基于两个核心原则构建DailyClue基准：(1)严格基于真实的日常活动，(2)设计具有挑战性的查询，需要超越表面感知。构建了涵盖4个主要日常领域和16个不同子任务的综合数据集。
AI.result: 对MLLMs和代理模型的全面评估表明，该基准测试提出了严峻挑战。分析揭示了几个关键见解，强调准确识别视觉线索对于稳健推理至关重要。
AI.conclusion: DailyClue基准填补了现有评估在视觉线索驱动推理能力方面的空白，突出了MLLMs在日常场景中需要更强的视觉线索识别和推理能力，为未来模型发展提供了重要方向。

title: Decoding the Delta: Unifying Remote Sensing Change Detection and Understanding with Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel in general vision-language tasks, their application to remote sensing change understanding is hindered by a fundamental "temporal blindness". Existing architectures lack intrinsic mechanisms for multi-temporal contrastive reasoning and struggle with precise spatial grounding. To address this, we first introduce Delta-QA, a comprehensive benchmark comprising 180k visual question-answering samples. Delta-QA unifies pixel-level segmentation and visual question answering across bi- and tri-temporal scenarios, structuring change interpretation into four progressive cognitive dimensions. Methodologically, we propose Delta-LLaVA, a novel MLLM framework explicitly tailored for multi-temporal remote sensing interpretation. It overcomes the limitations of naive feature concatenation through three core innovations: a Change-Enhanced Attention module that systematically isolates and amplifies visual differences, a Change-SEG module utilizing Change Prior Embedding to extract differentiable difference features as input for the LLM, and Local Causal Attention to prevent cross-temporal contextual leakage. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Delta-LLaVA decisively outperforms leading generalist MLLMs and specialized segmentation models in complex change deduction and high-precision boundary localization, establishing a unified framework for earth observation intelligence.

AI.tldr: Delta-LLaVA：针对遥感变化理解的新型多模态大语言模型，通过Delta-QA基准和三个核心创新模块解决现有MLLMs的"时间盲区"问题
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大语言模型在通用视觉-语言任务上表现出色，但在遥感变化理解方面存在"时间盲区"问题。现有架构缺乏多时间对比推理的内在机制，且难以实现精确的空间定位。
AI.method: 1. 引入Delta-QA基准数据集（18万个视觉问答样本），统一像素级分割和视觉问答任务；2. 提出Delta-LLaVA框架，包含三个核心创新：变化增强注意力模块、Change-SEG模块（使用变化先验嵌入提取差异特征）、局部因果注意力机制。
AI.result: Delta-LLaVA在复杂变化推理和高精度边界定位方面显著优于领先的通用MLLMs和专用分割模型，为地球观测智能建立了统一框架。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过Delta-LLaVA框架成功解决了遥感变化理解中的"时间盲区"问题，为多时间遥感解释提供了有效的解决方案，在变化推理和空间定位方面取得了突破性进展。

title: Free Geometry: Refining 3D Reconstruction from Longer Versions of Itself
summary: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models are efficient but rigid: once trained, they perform inference in a zero-shot manner and cannot adapt to the test scene. As a result, visually plausible reconstructions often contain errors, particularly under occlusions, specularities, and ambiguous cues. To address this, we introduce Free Geometry, a framework that enables feed-forward 3D reconstruction models to self-evolve at test time without any 3D ground truth. Our key insight is that, when the model receives more views, it produces more reliable and view-consistent reconstructions. Leveraging this property, given a testing sequence, we mask a subset of frames to construct a self-supervised task. Free Geometry enforces cross-view feature consistency between representations from full and partial observations, while maintaining the pairwise relations implied by the held-out frames. This self-supervision allows for fast recalibration via lightweight LoRA updates, taking less than 2 minutes per dataset on a single GPU. Our approach consistently improves state-of-the-art foundation models, including Depth Anything 3 and VGGT, across 4 benchmark datasets, yielding an average improvement of 3.73% in camera pose accuracy and 2.88% in point map prediction. Code is available at https://github.com/hiteacherIamhumble/Free-Geometry .

AI.tldr: Free Geometry框架让前馈3D重建模型在测试时能够自我进化，通过自监督学习提升重建质量，无需3D真值标注
AI.motivation: 前馈3D重建模型虽然高效但缺乏适应性，测试时无法根据具体场景进行调整，导致在遮挡、镜面反射和模糊线索等情况下出现错误
AI.method: 利用多视角一致性原理，在测试序列中遮蔽部分帧构建自监督任务，通过强制全观测和部分观测之间的跨视角特征一致性，使用轻量级LoRA更新快速重新校准模型
AI.result: 在Depth Anything 3和VGGT等最先进基础模型上，在4个基准数据集上平均相机姿态精度提升3.73%，点云图预测提升2.88%，单GPU上每个数据集耗时不到2分钟
AI.conclusion: Free Geometry框架成功实现了前馈3D重建模型在测试时的自适应能力，通过自监督学习显著提升了重建质量，为3D重建领域提供了有效的测试时优化方案

title: OneHOI: Unifying Human-Object Interaction Generation and Editing
comment: Accepted at CVPR2026. This paper moves toward unifying HOI generation and editing within a single model
summary: Human-Object Interaction (HOI) modelling captures how humans act upon and relate to objects, typically expressed as <person, action, object> triplets. Existing approaches split into two disjoint families: HOI generation synthesises scenes from structured triplets and layout, but fails to integrate mixed conditions like HOI and object-only entities; and HOI editing modifies interactions via text, yet struggles to decouple pose from physical contact and scale to multiple interactions. We introduce OneHOI, a unified diffusion transformer framework that consolidates HOI generation and editing into a single conditional denoising process driven by shared structured interaction representations. At its core, the Relational Diffusion Transformer (R-DiT) models verb-mediated relations through role- and instance-aware HOI tokens, layout-based spatial Action Grounding, a Structured HOI Attention to enforce interaction topology, and HOI RoPE to disentangle multi-HOI scenes. Trained jointly with modality dropout on our HOI-Edit-44K, along with HOI and object-centric datasets, OneHOI supports layout-guided, layout-free, arbitrary-mask, and mixed-condition control, achieving state-of-the-art results across both HOI generation and editing. Code is available at https://jiuntian.github.io/OneHOI/.

AI.tldr: OneHOI是一个统一的扩散transformer框架，将HOI生成和编辑整合到单一的条件去噪过程中，通过共享的结构化交互表示实现混合条件控制。
AI.motivation: 现有HOI方法存在局限性：HOI生成方法只能从结构化三元组和布局合成场景，无法整合混合条件（如HOI和仅对象实体）；HOI编辑方法通过文本修改交互，但难以解耦姿势与物理接触，且难以扩展到多个交互。
AI.method: 提出OneHOI框架，核心是关系扩散transformer（R-DiT），通过角色和实例感知的HOI token、基于布局的空间动作定位、结构化HOI注意力来强制交互拓扑，以及HOI RoPE来解耦多HOI场景。采用模态dropout联合训练，支持布局引导、无布局、任意掩码和混合条件控制。
AI.result: 在HOI生成和编辑任务上都取得了最先进的结果，能够处理多种控制条件。
AI.conclusion: OneHOI提供了一个统一的框架，成功整合了HOI生成和编辑功能，通过共享的结构化交互表示实现了更灵活和强大的HOI建模能力。

title: Towards Unconstrained Human-Object Interaction
comment: Accepted to the 20th IEEE International Conference on Automatic Face and Gesture Recognition (FG 2026)
summary: Human-Object Interaction (HOI) detection is a longstanding computer vision problem concerned with predicting the interaction between humans and objects. Current HOI models rely on a vocabulary of interactions at training and inference time, limiting their applicability to static environments. With the advent of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), it has become feasible to explore more flexible paradigms for interaction recognition. In this work, we revisit HOI detection through the lens of MLLMs and apply them to in-the-wild HOI detection. We define the Unconstrained HOI (U-HOI) task, a novel HOI domain that removes the requirement for a predefined list of interactions at both training and inference. We evaluate a range of MLLMs on this setting and introduce a pipeline that includes test-time inference and language-to-graph conversion to extract structured interactions from free-form text. Our findings highlight the limitations of current HOI detectors and the value of MLLMs for U-HOI. Code will be available at https://github.com/francescotonini/anyhoi

AI.tldr: 本文提出无约束人-物交互检测任务，利用多模态大语言模型解决传统HOI检测依赖预定义交互词汇的限制，实现开放环境下的交互识别。
AI.motivation: 当前人-物交互检测模型依赖于训练和推理时的预定义交互词汇，限制了其在静态环境外的应用。随着多模态大语言模型的发展，探索更灵活的交互识别范式成为可能。
AI.method: 定义了无约束HOI任务，移除了预定义交互列表的要求；评估了多种MLLMs在此设置下的表现；提出了包含测试时推理和语言到图转换的流程，从自由格式文本中提取结构化交互信息。
AI.result: 研究结果突显了当前HOI检测器的局限性，并展示了MLLMs在无约束HOI任务中的价值。
AI.conclusion: 通过MLLMs重新审视HOI检测，提出了无约束HOI任务，为开放环境下的交互识别提供了新范式，证明了MLLMs在该领域的应用潜力。

title: Training-Free Semantic Multi-Object Tracking with Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted to the 20th IEEE International Conference on Automatic Face and Gesture Recognition (FG 2026)
summary: Semantic Multi-Object Tracking (SMOT) extends multi-object tracking with semantic outputs such as video summaries, instance-level captions, and interaction labels, aiming to move from trajectories to human-interpretable descriptions of dynamic scenes. Existing SMOT systems are trained end-to-end, coupling progress to expensive supervision, limiting the ability to rapidly adapt to new foundation models and new interactions. We propose TF-SMOT, a training-free SMOT pipeline that composes pretrained components for detection, mask-based tracking, and video-language generation. TF-SMOT combines D-FINE and the promptable SAM2 segmentation tracker to produce temporally consistent tracklets, uses contour grounding to generate video summaries and instance captions with InternVideo2.5, and aligns extracted interaction predicates to BenSMOT WordNet synsets via gloss-based semantic retrieval with LLM disambiguation. On BenSMOT, TF-SMOT achieves state-of-the-art tracking performance within the SMOT setting and improves summary and caption quality compared to prior art. Interaction recognition, however, remains challenging under strict exact-match evaluation on the fine-grained and long-tailed WordNet label space; our analysis and ablations indicate that semantic overlap and label granularity substantially affect measured performance.

AI.tldr: TF-SMOT是一个无需训练的语义多目标跟踪系统，通过组合预训练组件实现检测、跟踪和视频语言生成，在BenSMOT基准上达到SOTA跟踪性能，但交互识别在细粒度WordNet标签空间仍具挑战性。
AI.motivation: 现有SMOT系统采用端到端训练，依赖昂贵的监督数据，难以快速适应新的基础模型和交互类型。需要一种无需训练的方法来灵活组合预训练组件，实现语义多目标跟踪。
AI.method: TF-SMOT组合预训练组件：使用D-FINE和SAM2分割跟踪器生成时序一致的轨迹；通过轮廓接地技术结合InternVideo2.5生成视频摘要和实例描述；利用基于词义的语义检索和LLM消歧将交互谓词对齐到BenSMOT WordNet同义词集。
AI.result: 在BenSMOT基准上，TF-SMOT在SMOT设置下达到最先进的跟踪性能，相比先前方法提升了摘要和描述质量。但交互识别在严格的精确匹配评估下仍具挑战性，语义重叠和标签粒度显著影响性能测量。
AI.conclusion: TF-SMOT展示了无需训练方法在语义多目标跟踪中的有效性，能够灵活组合预训练组件。然而，在细粒度、长尾分布的WordNet标签空间中进行交互识别仍然困难，需要进一步研究语义相似性度量和评估方法。

title: Don't Let the Video Speak: Audio-Contrastive Preference Optimization for Audio-Visual Language Models
summary: While Audio-Visual Language Models (AVLMs) have achieved remarkable progress over recent years, their reliability is bottlenecked by cross-modal hallucination. A particularly pervasive manifestation is video-driven audio hallucination: models routinely exploit visual shortcuts to hallucinate expected sounds, discarding true auditory evidence. To counteract this deeply ingrained visual dominance, we propose Audio-Contrastive Preference Optimization (ACPO). This dual-axis preference learning framework introduces an output-contrastive objective to penalize visual descriptions masquerading as audio facts, alongside an input-contrastive objective that swaps audio tracks to explicitly penalize generation invariant to the true auditory signal. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ACPO establishes highly faithful audio grounding and mitigates audio hallucination without compromising overarching multimodal capabilities.

AI.tldr: ACPO框架通过输出对比和输入对比目标，有效减少音频-视觉语言模型中的跨模态幻觉问题，特别是视频驱动的音频幻觉，提升音频真实性而不损害整体多模态能力。
AI.motivation: 音频-视觉语言模型存在跨模态幻觉问题，特别是视频驱动的音频幻觉：模型经常利用视觉捷径来幻觉预期的声音，而忽略真实的听觉证据。这种视觉主导的偏见影响了模型的可靠性。
AI.method: 提出音频对比偏好优化（ACPO）框架，包含两个对比学习目标：1）输出对比目标：惩罚伪装成音频事实的视觉描述；2）输入对比目标：通过交换音频轨道，明确惩罚对真实听觉信号不变的生成。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，ACPO建立了高度忠实的音频基础，有效缓解了音频幻觉问题，同时不损害整体的多模态能力。
AI.conclusion: ACPO通过双重对比学习框架成功解决了音频-视觉语言模型中的跨模态幻觉问题，特别是视频驱动的音频幻觉，提高了模型的音频真实性和可靠性。

title: ROSE: Retrieval-Oriented Segmentation Enhancement
summary: Existing segmentation models based on multimodal large language models (MLLMs), such as LISA, often struggle with novel or emerging entities due to their inability to incorporate up-to-date knowledge. To address this challenge, we introduce the Novel Emerging Segmentation Task (NEST), which focuses on segmenting (i) novel entities that MLLMs fail to recognize due to their absence from training data, and (ii) emerging entities that exist within the model's knowledge but demand up-to-date external information for accurate recognition. To support the study of NEST, we construct a NEST benchmark using an automated pipeline that generates news-related data samples for comprehensive evaluation. Additionally, we propose ROSE: Retrieval-Oriented Segmentation Enhancement, a plug-and-play framework designed to augment any MLLM-based segmentation model. ROSE comprises four key components. First, an Internet Retrieval-Augmented Generation module is introduced to employ user-provided multimodal inputs to retrieve real-time web information. Then, a Textual Prompt Enhancer enriches the model with up-to-date information and rich background knowledge, improving the model's perception ability for emerging entities. Furthermore, a Visual Prompt Enhancer is proposed to compensate for MLLMs' lack of exposure to novel entities by leveraging internet-sourced images. To maintain efficiency, a WebSense module is introduced to intelligently decide when to invoke retrieval mechanisms based on user input. Experimental results demonstrate that ROSE significantly boosts performance on the NEST benchmark, outperforming a strong Gemini-2.0 Flash-based retrieval baseline by 19.2 in gIoU.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多模态大语言模型在分割新出现实体时的局限性，提出了NEST任务和ROSE框架，通过检索增强技术提升模型对新颖和新兴实体的分割能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基于多模态大语言模型的分割模型（如LISA）在处理新颖或新兴实体时表现不佳，主要原因是无法融入最新知识。这些模型难以识别训练数据中未出现的新颖实体，以及需要最新外部信息才能准确识别的新兴实体。
AI.method: 提出了NEST任务来专门研究新颖和新兴实体的分割问题，并构建了NEST基准数据集。同时提出了ROSE框架，包含四个关键组件：1）互联网检索增强生成模块，利用用户提供的多模态输入检索实时网络信息；2）文本提示增强器，用最新信息和丰富背景知识增强模型；3）视觉提示增强器，利用网络来源图像补偿模型对新实体的认知不足；4）WebSense模块，智能决定何时触发检索机制以保持效率。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，ROSE在NEST基准上显著提升了性能，比基于Gemini-2.0 Flash的检索基线在gIoU指标上高出19.2分。
AI.conclusion: ROSE框架有效解决了多模态大语言模型在处理新颖和新兴实体分割时的局限性，通过检索增强技术显著提升了模型性能，为这一领域的研究提供了新的解决方案。

title: Seedance 2.0: Advancing Video Generation for World Complexity
summary: Seedance 2.0 is a new native multi-modal audio-video generation model, officially released in China in early February 2026. Compared with its predecessors, Seedance 1.0 and 1.5 Pro, Seedance 2.0 adopts a unified, highly efficient, and large-scale architecture for multi-modal audio-video joint generation. This allows it to support four input modalities: text, image, audio, and video, by integrating one of the most comprehensive suites of multi-modal content reference and editing capabilities available in the industry to date. It delivers substantial, well-rounded improvements across all key sub-dimensions of video and audio generation. In both expert evaluations and public user tests, the model has demonstrated performance on par with the leading levels in the field. Seedance 2.0 supports direct generation of audio-video content with durations ranging from 4 to 15 seconds, with native output resolutions of 480p and 720p. For multi-modal inputs as reference, its current open platform supports up to 3 video clips, 9 images, and 3 audio clips. In addition, we provide Seedance 2.0 Fast version, an accelerated variant of Seedance 2.0 designed to boost generation speed for low-latency scenarios. Seedance 2.0 has delivered significant improvements to its foundational generation capabilities and multi-modal generation performance, bringing an enhanced creative experience for end users.

AI.tldr: Seedance 2.0是中国2026年2月发布的多模态音视频生成模型，支持文本、图像、音频、视频四种输入，能生成4-15秒的480p/720p音视频内容，性能达到行业领先水平。
AI.motivation: 开发一个统一、高效、大规模的多模态音视频联合生成架构，提供业界最全面的多模态内容参考和编辑能力，全面提升音视频生成质量。
AI.method: 采用统一的多模态音视频联合生成架构，支持四种输入模态（文本、图像、音频、视频），平台支持最多3个视频片段、9张图像、3个音频片段作为参考输入。
AI.result: 在专家评估和公开用户测试中表现达到领域领先水平，支持生成4-15秒的480p/720p音视频内容，并提供了加速版本Seedance 2.0 Fast用于低延迟场景。
AI.conclusion: Seedance 2.0在基础生成能力和多模态生成性能方面取得显著改进，为终端用户提供了增强的创作体验，是多模态音视频生成领域的重要进展。

title: One Token per Highly Selective Frame: Towards Extreme Compression for Long Video Understanding
summary: Long video understanding is inherently challenging for vision-language models (VLMs) because of the extensive number of frames. With each video frame typically expanding into tens or hundreds of tokens, the limited context length of large language models (LLMs) forces the VLMs to perceive the frames sparsely and lose temporal information. To address this, we explore extreme video token compression towards \emph{one token per frame} at the final LLM layer. Our key insight is that heuristic-based compression, widely adopted by previous methods, is prone to information loss, and this necessitates supervising LLM layers into \emph{learnable} and \emph{progressive} modules for \emph{token-level compression} (LP-Comp). Such compression enables our VLM to digest 2x-4x more frames with improved performance. To further increase the token efficiency, we investigate \emph{frame-level compression}, which selects the frames most relevant to the queries via the internal attention scores of the LLM layers, named \emph{question-conditioned compression} (QC-Comp). As a notable distinction from previous studies, we mitigate the position bias of LLM attention in long contexts, \emph{i.e.}, the over-concentration on the beginning and end of a sequence, by splitting long videos into short segments and employing local attention. Collectively, our combined \emph{token-level} and \emph{frame-level} leads to an e\textbf{x}treme compression model for long video understanding, named \textbf{\name}, achieving a significantly larger compression ratio and enabling denser frame sampling. Our \name is finetuned from VideoChat-Flash with a data-efficient \emph{supervised compression tuning} stage that only requires 2.5\% of the supervised fine-tuning data, yet boosts the accuracy from 42.9\% to 46.2\% on LVBench and enhances multiple other long video benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为X-Comp的极端视频压缩模型，通过token级和帧级压缩技术，实现每帧仅用一个token的极端压缩，显著提升长视频理解能力。
AI.motivation: 长视频理解对视觉语言模型具有挑战性，因为大量视频帧会产生过多token，超出大语言模型的上下文长度限制，导致模型只能稀疏感知帧并丢失时间信息。
AI.method: 提出LP-Comp（可学习渐进式token级压缩）和QC-Comp（问题条件帧级压缩）两种压缩技术。LP-Comp通过监督LLM层实现可学习的token压缩；QC-Comp利用LLM内部注意力分数选择与查询最相关的帧。同时通过分割长视频为短片段并使用局部注意力来缓解位置偏差。
AI.result: X-Comp模型实现了2-4倍的帧数处理能力提升，在LVBench上准确率从42.9%提升至46.2%，并在多个长视频基准测试中表现优异。仅需2.5%的监督微调数据即可实现这些改进。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合token级和帧级压缩技术，X-Comp实现了极端视频压缩，显著提升了长视频理解能力，同时保持了数据效率。
